title: A Suona Shakes Heaven and Earth
description: Lin Chuan, a legendary musician known as the Music God, survives a car accident only to return three years later to find traditional music under threat from foreign rivals.
context:
Title: A Suona Shakes Heaven and Earth
Description: Lin Chuan, a legendary musician known as the Music God, survives a car accident only to return three years later to find traditional music under threat from foreign rivals.

INT. CONCERT HALL STAGE - NIGHT

Darkness. A spotlight ignites, cutting through swirling smoke. LIN CHUAN (30s, calloused hands, intense focus) emerges, raising a gleaming suona.

CLOSE-UP - LIN CHUAN's fingers dance across the instrument's holes with practiced precision.

The suona BLARES to life - a soaring, defiant melody that commands the hall.

INT. CONCERT HALL AUDIENCE - NIGHT

The house is packed. In the front row, MATSUSHITA SHAEKO (40s, elegant, granite composure) watches Lin Chuan's technique, her eyes sharp and assessing.

INT. CONCERT HALL STAGE - NIGHT

Lin's performance builds to a climax, every muscle coiled. The final note hangs, piercing and perfect.

He lowers the suona, breathing hard.

The audience erupts. Thunderous applause and cheers.

AUDIENCE (O.S.)
Music God! Encore!

An EMCEE appears with a golden trophy. Confetti rains down.

EMCEE (V.O.)
For the third consecutive year - Lin Chuan of Daxia.

ON SCREEN: LIN CHUAN - THREE-TIME WORLD CHAMPION

INT. SEDAN CAR - NIGHT

Lin sits in the dark backseat, trophy glinting. The DRIVER's eyes flick to the rearview mirror.

DRIVER
Mr. Lin. That sedan's been with us since the venue.

Lin turns. Headlights fill the rear window.

LIN CHUAN
Lose them.

The Driver accelerates onto a mountain highway. The pursuing car surges forward, BUMPING their rear bumper.

DRIVER
They're trying to--

The pursuing vehicle RAMS them again, harder. Tires scream.
continuation:
INT./EXT. SEDAN CAR - MOUNTAIN ROAD - CONTINUOUS

The car careens through a guardrail and plunges down the slope.

EXT. MOUNTAIN ROAD - NIGHT

The sedan lies twisted at the bottom, smoke billowing.

A figure at the roadside watches, then melts into darkness.

ON SCREEN: MUSIC GOD LIN CHUAN - ACCIDENT - FATE UNKNOWN

INT. INSTRUMENT SHOP - DAY

Sunlight illuminates dusty rows of traditional instruments. A small TV flickers silently in the corner. SU YING (30s, weary but determined) works at the counter. Her sister SU WAN (20s, fiery) polishes a pipa.

ON SCREEN: THREE YEARS LATER

The door chimes. CHEN JIANGHAI (40s, corporate polish, predatory smile) enters with TAKEDA TARO (50s, distinguished, inscrutable).

SU YING
Can I help you?

Chen picks up a suona, examining it with a slight smile.

SU YING
All our instruments are performance-grade. You're welcome to try them.

Chen sets it down with a sharp TAP. The reed cracks audibly.

Su Wan rushes over.

SU WAN
That was deliberate.

CHEN JIANGHAI
I'm Chen Jianghai, Jiangbei representative for the International Music Development Council.

He produces a card.

CHEN JIANGHAI
And this is Takeda Taro, Special Advisor to the Ishikawa Music Hall.

ON SCREEN: CHEN JIANGHAI - INTERNATIONAL MUSIC DEVELOPMENT COUNCIL

ON SCREEN: TAKEDA TARO - ISHIKAWA MUSIC HALL ADVISOR

SU YING
(frowning)
What do you want?

TAKEDA TARO
(bows slightly)
The Ishikawa Hall is establishing a cultural exchange in Jiangbei. With sponsored instruments for all major academies.

CHEN JIANGHAI
We're inviting local partners. Or competitors.

He slides a sealed black envelope across the counter.

CHEN JIANGHAI
Our proposal. Accept, and your instruments reach three hundred students. Refuse...

He glances at the broken suona.

CHEN JIANGHAI
...and we demonstrate why some traditions belong in museums.

SU YING's hand trembles as she reaches for the envelope.
group_id: a suona shakes heaven and earth

title: Wife's Return
description: A woman fights for survival while her estranged husband races to save her, forcing both to confront the cost of their choices.
context:
Title: Wife's Return
Description: A woman fights for survival while her estranged husband races to save her, forcing both to confront the cost of their choices.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

SU MO, 26, kneels in a torn gold dress, suspended by chains. She forces shallow breaths, scanning the warehouse.

ASSISTANT (V.O.)
(phone filter)
Tracker confirms Chenglin warehouse. But sir, Mrs. Huo—

HUO SIHAN (V.O.)
(phone filter)
She knew the risks.

A WHIP cracks across Su Mo's back. She chokes back a scream.

The KIDNAPPER, 40s, checks his phone.

KIDNAPPER
Your husband's not responding. Maybe I need to be more persuasive.

SU MO
(strained)
He won't pay. We're separated. Bad intel.

KIDNAPPER
(showing screen)
This says Mrs. Huo. This says two million pending.

SU MO
(desperate)
Not his money. Please, I can explain—

KIDNAPPER
Wrong answer.

He raises the whip.

EXT. HIGHWAY - NIGHT

Rain pelts the road. A white sports car weaves through traffic.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

HUO SIHAN, 32, watches Su Mo's location pulse on his phone. His jaw is tight.

The ASSISTANT balances a tablet.

ASSISTANT
Company funds are ready, but the prenup—paying legally validates the marriage.

HUO SIHAN
Use the offshore account. Not mine.

DRIVER
Seventeen minutes out. Police are slower.

HUO SIHAN
Drive faster.
continuation:
INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Su Mo's head lolls. She counts silently, eyes tracking exits.

KIDNAPPER
(into phone)
You guaranteed he'd pay.

SU MO
(whisper)
Huo Sihan... don't.

KIDNAPPER
Rich bitches always think you're special.

SU MO
(looking up)
I was leaving him. That's why he—

CRACK. The whip again.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

Red brake lights fill the windshield. The Driver hits the horn.

DRIVER
Accident ahead. Detour?

Huo Sihan checks the map—five minutes out.

HUO SIHAN
Take the shoulder.

DRIVER
Sir—

HUO SIHAN
Now.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

Su Mo spits blood, defiant.

SU MO
Wrong account. The two million is mine. Pre-marriage.

The Kidnapper freezes, rechecks his screen.

SU MO
He's not coming.

The Kidnapper's face hardens.

KIDNAPPER
Then you're dead.

He draws a knife. Su Mo's breath catches.

INT. SPORTS CAR - NIGHT

Huo Sihan's phone BUZZES. A text from Su Mo: "Don't come."

He stares. Then locks the screen.

HUO SIHAN
South entrance. Go dark.

DRIVER
Yes sir.

The car veers off-road.

INT. WAREHOUSE - NIGHT

The knife glints. Su Mo shuts her eyes—

A SHOT rings out. The knife hits concrete.

HUO SIHAN (O.S.)
She's not dead yet.

The Kidnapper whirls. Huo Sihan stands in the doorframe, weapon raised, rain-soaked.

SU MO
(barely breathing)
You shouldn't have.

Huo Sihan's eyes stay on the Kidnapper.

HUO SIHAN
We need to talk.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Impostor Goddess
description: A novelist celebrating her book publication discovers a glowing copy of her own novel in a restroom and is mysteriously transported into the world of her story.
context:
Title: Impostor Goddess
Description: A novelist celebrating her book publication discovers a glowing copy of her own novel in a restroom and is mysteriously transported into the world of her story.

EXT. ROOFTOP - NIGHT

City night view, tall buildings everywhere, lights shining brightly.

A group of friends are having a party on the rooftop, celebrating XIE WANQING's novel publication.

FRIEND A
Let's toast to our Wanqing, the great author, for her novel publication, cheers!

EVERYONE
Cheers!

Everyone raises their glasses and drinks them down.

FRIEND B
I wish your novel becomes a bestseller.

XIE WANQING
A bestseller.

FRIEND B
It will definitely be a bestseller.

XIE WANQING drinks, appearing somewhat tipsy. She continues drinking and celebrating with her friends.

After a while, XIE WANQING feels a bit dizzy and stands up.

XIE WANQING
I'm going to the restroom first. You guys keep drinking, I'll be right back.

XIE WANQING walks somewhat unsteadily.

FRIEND C
Are you okay?

XIE WANQING
I'm fine, fine, fine.

FRIEND D
Don't drink too much.

XIE WANQING
I'm fine.

XIE WANQING leaves the party alone.
continuation:
INT. RESTROOM - NIGHT

XIE WANQING enters the restroom, tidies up her appearance in the mirror, then walks to the sink to wash her hands.

She fixes her hair and turns to leave when she notices a glowing book on the floor.

Curious, she walks over and crouches down to pick up the book.

The cover has her name written on it: "XIE WANQING."

XIE WANQING
(to herself)
How is my book here?

She opens the book. Golden text floats around her, all plot points and character names from her novel, such as "Male Lead: BAI SHAN," "Female Lead: LUO XI."

A flash of white light appears, and XIE WANQING disappears.

INT. UNKNOWN LOCATION - DAY

Two men's shadows are projected on the wall. One of them is on the phone.

MAN A (V.O.)
Alright, we don't need to discuss this anymore.

MAN A (V.O.)
By the way, is there any news about her?

INT. INDOOR SWIMMING POOL - DAY

A woman in a white dress (looking identical to XIE WANQING) struggles in the pool, about to drown.

DROWNING WOMAN
Ah!

A man (BAI SHAN) quickly jumps into the water and swims toward the drowning woman.

BAI SHAN rescues the woman and brings her to the poolside, laying her flat.

He immediately performs CPR and mouth-to-mouth resuscitation on the woman.

As he performs mouth-to-mouth resuscitation, a golden light flashes.

FADE OUT.

title: Return to Shanghai Bund - Rising to the Top
description: A boxer loses a match to save his wife, but arrives too late. A mystical amulet sends him back to 1847 Shanghai, where he gets a second chance.
context:
Title: Return to Shanghai Bund - Rising to the Top
Description: A boxer loses a match to save his wife, but arrives too late. A mystical amulet sends him back to 1847 Shanghai, where he gets a second chance.

INT. BOXING GYM - NIGHT

On the boxing ring, LIN YUAN and TAI SHAN are in an intense match. The audience below is excited, shouting and cheering loudly.

After several rounds, TAI SHAN pins LIN YUAN to the ground.

TAI SHAN
(whispering)
The money's already in your account. Stay down. Think of Ruo Qi.

LIN YUAN
(whispering)
Your belt... your career...

TAI SHAN
Just a belt. You keep your word.

TAI SHAN releases LIN YUAN, who stays down. The match continues.

LIN YUAN's voice echoes in TAI SHAN's mind.

LIN YUAN (V.O.)
You keep your word.

TAI SHAN knocks LIN YUAN to the ground with one punch.

The REFEREE raises TAI SHAN's hand.

REFEREE
In this boxing championship, Tai Shan wins!

The audience angrily throws things at the stage.

AUDIENCE
Refund! Refund! Can't you fight properly!
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

LIN YUAN runs anxiously to a DOCTOR and shows his phone.

LIN YUAN
Doctor, the transfer cleared! Start the treatment!

DOCTOR
I'm sorry, Mr. Lin. We needed it hours ago. Say your goodbyes.

LIN YUAN
(grabbing the doctor's collar)
Then why did you tell me—

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - DAY

LIN YUAN rushes to RUO QI's bedside. RUO QI lies weakly on the bed.

LIN YUAN
Ruo Qi! I got the money. I did it.

RUO QI
You threw it... your shot... for nothing...

RUO QI takes out an amulet.

RUO QI
This is for your next fight... so you never lose again. Find me there.

RUO QI puts the amulet around LIN YUAN's neck.

The heart monitor flatlines with a long beep.

LIN YUAN
(shouting)
Ruo Qi! Ruo Qi! Ruo Qi!

The amulet around LIN YUAN's neck emits a dazzling green light.

MONTAGE

Quick flashes of outer space, Earth, ancient sailing ships, the year 1847, a time tunnel, and other images.

EXT. SHANGHAI BUND STREET - NIGHT

LIN YUAN, dressed in Republic-era clothing, sits in a rickshaw, looking bewildered.

A rickshaw puller, XIANG ZI, stands beside the cart.

XIANG ZI
Ruo Qi.

LIN YUAN
(confused)
Ruo Qi?

XIANG ZI
Ruo Qi!

LIN YUAN looks at the unfamiliar surroundings and realizes he has traveled through time.

title: Reborn: Medical Hands Cover the Sky
description: A man who sacrificed everything for love is reborn after a tragic death, discovering he has returned with mysterious powers.
context:
Title: Reborn: Medical Hands Cover the Sky
Description: A man who sacrificed everything for love is reborn after a tragic death, discovering he has returned with mysterious powers.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

NURSES wheel a gurney with LING CHEN through the corridor. He convulses violently, foam flecking his lips.

NURSE
Make way! Poisoning case!

They crash through the OR doors.

FLASHBACK TO:

EXT. HOSPITAL PLAZA - DAY

QIAN TING collapses at LING CHEN's feet in the pouring rain.

QIAN TING
(crying)
Ling Chen... malignant tumor. I need a living donor. Can't afford the tests.

LING CHEN helps her up, his fingers pressing her pulse. His eyes shimmer with inner light.

LING CHEN
I'll get tested. Don't worry about the cost.

QIAN TING
(moved)
You'd really do that... for me?

She hugs him. Over his shoulder, her smile turns triumphant.
continuation:
INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

LING CHEN lies anesthetized, oxygen mask on. DOCTOR LI operates laparoscopically.

NURSE
Doctor, pressure's dropping. The tissue is regenerating as we cut.

DOCTOR LI
Note the anomaly. Increase fluids.

The monitor flickers with impossible readings.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

LING CHEN kneels. QIAN TING packs a suitcase.

LING CHEN
Qian Ting, the doctors said I almost died on that table.

QIAN TING slaps him hard.

QIAN TING
I stayed one year. We're even.

LING CHEN
(pleading)
Don't leave me with the debt. Please.

QIAN TING
You volunteered. Sign the papers.

LING CHEN
(desperate)
I gave you my liver...

QIAN TING
(quietly)
And I gave you a year. Now get it over with.

An empty pill bottle rolls to his feet.

LING CHEN
If that's what you truly want...

He swallows the remaining pills. QIAN TING watches, frozen, as he collapses.

BACK TO PRESENT:

INT. OPERATING ROOM - DAY

DOCTOR LI attempts resuscitation. Asystole.

DOCTOR LI
Time of death, 14:37.

The monitor flatlines. The team steps back.

Suddenly, LING CHEN bolts upright, ripping off his mask. His eyes glow faintly blue.

LING CHEN
(whispering)
The tribulation... I survived?

He looks at his hands. Surgical scars fade. The monitor starts beeping—perfect rhythm.

LING CHEN
What am I now?

The room shifts. Sterile walls become a white, ethereal space.

LING CHEN
Who are you?
group_id: reborn: medical hands cover the sky

title: Ex-Husband Gains Mind Reading After Divorce
description: A woman threatens to jump from a building to prevent divorce, but her husband coldly calls her bluff. After a car accident, he gains the ability to hear her inner thoughts.
context:
Title: Ex-Husband Gains Mind Reading After Divorce
Description: A woman threatens to jump from a building to prevent divorce, but her husband coldly calls her bluff. After a car accident, he gains the ability to hear her inner thoughts.

EXT. OFFICE BUILDING - DAY

LIN XUEZHI (28, porcelain defiance in a battered bridal gown) stands at the rooftop edge.

Below, HE YAN (35, tailored suit tailored cruelty) and his assistant ZHANG YUAN (30s, nervous energy) look up.

LIN XUEZHI
He Yan! If you divorce me, I'll jump!

HE YAN
(coldly)
Third building this month. Try the north tower—it's taller.

LIN XUEZHI
(angrily)
You bastard!

HE YAN
Now you're getting it.

He turns to leave.

ZHANG YUAN
(worried)
President He, the reporters—

HE YAN
Will have to find a new story. She won't jump.

LIN XUEZHI
(shouting)
He Yan! I will never sign those papers!

A black sedan SCREENS around the corner and speeds toward them, horn BLARING.

HE YAN shoves ZHANG YUAN aside. The sedan clips him. He crumples, head cracking against pavement.

LIN XUEZHI
(scream)
HE YAN!

She sprints for the fire escape.
continuation:
EXT. CITY STREET - CONTINUOUS

LIN XUEZHI cradles HE YAN, blood pooling beneath his head.

LIN XUEZHI
(frantically)
He Yan! Please—

HE YAN
(weakly)
Am I—

LIN XUEZHI (V.O.)
 dying? God. I wanted to hurt you, not kill you. I wanted you to need me. If you die, I'm still Mrs. He. The shares. The will. Stop. Think of him, not the money. The money is just... security. If he lives.

LIN XUEZHI
(trembling)
He Yan, don't leave me...

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

HE YAN lies unconscious, head wrapped, eyes closed. ZHANG YUAN stands nearby.

The door bursts open. LIN XUEZHI, in wrinkled casual clothes, rushes in.

She seizes his hand.

LIN XUEZHI
(crying softly)
He Yan. He Yan, wake up.

ZHANG YUAN
Madam, his monitors—

HE YAN slowly opens his eyes.

LIN XUEZHI
(gasp)
He Yan—

LIN XUEZHI (V.O.)
 —thank God. The prenup is void if he dies. No. Stop. I just want him to see me. Not the contract. Me.

HE YAN stares at her, hearing every silent word.
group_id: ex-husband gains mind reading after divorce

title: Family Forces Me to Take the Blame for Ten Years for Adopted Son
description: A man returns to his birth family after ten years, only to be forced to take the blame for a crime committed by his adopted brother.
context:
Title: Family Forces Me to Take the Blame for Ten Years for Adopted Son
Description: A man returns to his birth family after ten years, only to be forced to take the blame for a crime committed by his adopted brother.

INT. YUAN FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

A television news broadcast is playing.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
Special report: A serious fire has broken out in the new district. According to sources, police are naming Yuan Yu, son of the Yuan family, as a person of interest.

YUAN MOTHER holds the trembling YUAN JUN protectively. YUAN FATHER sits rigid, his expression grave. The family watches in tense silence.

YUAN YU rushes into the living room.

YUAN YU
The police just called. You told them it was me?

YUAN SHUANG stands to the side and slams down her cup.

YUAN SHUANG
A-Jun didn't mean for this to happen. He needs help, not prison.

YUAN SHUANG
(pausing)
You can survive this. He can't.
continuation:
YUAN YU
(in disbelief)
What?

YUAN FATHER stands up from the sofa and walks over to YUAN YU.

YUAN FATHER
It's okay, son.

YUAN FATHER
That's why it has to be you. He wouldn't last.

YUAN MOTHER
(holding YUAN JUN, speaking to YUAN YU)
A-Yu, please. It's only until we sort this out.

YUAN YU
(emotionally agitated)
Dad, Mom, Sis... I'm your biological son. Ten years I waited to come home. And him? He's—

YUAN FATHER suddenly slaps YUAN YU across the face.

YUAN FATHER
You ungrateful bastard.

YUAN YU covers his face, looking at his father in shock.
group_id: family forces me to take the blame for ten years for adopted son

title: The Handsome Husband in the Jade Hairpin - Episode 1
description: A college student trapped in a nightmare finds herself forced into a ghostly wedding with the King of Hell, only to wake up to a horrifying reality.
context:
Title: The Handsome Husband in the Jade Hairpin - Episode 1
Description: A college student trapped in a nightmare finds herself forced into a ghostly wedding with the King of Hell, only to wake up to a horrifying reality.

INT. FEMALE DORMITORY - NIGHT

ON SCREEN: Haicheng University - Female Dormitory

MU WAN lies on the top bunk of her dormitory bed, surrounded by crumpled talismans. She twitches in a nightmare.

INT. ANCIENT BRIDAL CHAMBER - NIGHT

MU WAN wears a red wedding dress, lying on an antique wedding bed, her hands bound by red silk cords.

MALE VOICE (V.O.)
The King of Hell claims his bride. The living shall not interfere.

MU WAN opens her eyes, breath misting in the cold. She strains against the cords.

MU WAN (V.O.)
A ghost wedding... the bride is me.

She spots an ornate mirror—her reflection shows the bridal veil.

MU WAN
Grandma's charms failed. This can't be real.

She struggles, trying to reactivate the faded ink on her palm with spit and friction, muttering protective mantras.

A figure materializes: KING OF HELL in crimson wedding robes, black silk sash covering his eyes.

KING OF HELL (V.O.)
Need help, little bride?

MU WAN
(desperate)
Yes! Cut these ropes—I'll pay you anything, just get me out!

She freezes. His robes match hers—the same phoenix embroidery.

MU WAN
Your clothes...
continuation:
The KING OF HELL helps her untie the cloth strips on his hands. Just as MU WAN tries to escape, the KING OF HELL grabs her and pins her down on the bed.

KING OF HELL
Where are you running?

MU WAN
(panicking)
My grandmother's a medium—she'll banish you!

He touches the jade hairpin to her lips.

KING OF HELL
She protected you for twenty years. Tonight, her ink ran dry.

He kisses her. The hairpin falls.

INT. FEMALE DORMITORY - DAY

KING OF HELL (V.O.)
A gift awaits you.

MU WAN jolts awake, gasping. Talismans litter her blanket.

Noisy voices outside.

PASSERBY (O.S.)
Someone jumped! Call 911!

MU WAN immediately gets out of bed and rushes to the window, knocks over red ink—spills across a torn photo of her with two girls, their faces scratched out.

EXT. BELOW DORMITORY BUILDING - DAY

Two female corpses lie on concrete. Blood pools. A bystander's phone shows a video: two girls throwing a notebook off the roof, laughing.

INT. FEMALE DORMITORY - DAY

MU WAN looks at the tragic scene below, her face deathly pale, her eyes filled with shock and terror.

MU WAN (V.O.)
The gift... from my nightmare husband?

Her hand finds the jade hairpin on her windowsill.
group_id: the handsome husband in the jade hairpin -

title: Social Butterfly Baby Saves Cannon Fodder Mom in Period Drama
description: A modern reader transmigrates into a period novel as the weak female lead who must stand up to her oppressive in-laws to protect her genius twins.
context:
Title: Social Butterfly Baby Saves Cannon Fodder Mom in Period Drama
Description: A modern reader transmigrates into a period novel as the weak female lead who must stand up to her oppressive in-laws to protect her genius twins.

INT. READER'S HOME - NIGHT

A young woman (NOVEL READER) in a white nightgown lies on the sofa, focused on reading a novel on her phone.

NOVEL READER
(sighing)
Tian Cuifen... you vicious old bat.

She stares at the text on her phone screen, frowning, getting more and more angry.

NOVEL READER
(in disbelief)
How is she putting up with this?

She suddenly sits up from the sofa, throws her phone aside, and stands up in anger.

NOVEL READER
(furious)
That's it! This story is infuriating! The heroine has a battalion commander husband, gave birth to brilliant twins, and what does she do? Lets her in-laws bleed her dry while her children suffer.

The more she thinks about it, the angrier she gets, and she starts pacing around the room.

NOVEL READER
(talking to herself)
If it were me...

She suddenly stops, her eyes determined, and starts gesturing.

NOVEL READER
(excitedly)
I'd kick that biased mother-in-law to the curb and knock that leech of a sister-in-law flat!

She makes kicking and punching motions, as if venting her emotions.

NOVEL READER
(satisfied)
That's more like it.

After venting, she calms down and sees a document on the table. She picks it up to look. It's a diagnosis report.

NOVEL READER
(dejected)
Infertile. If I could be like the heroine and have two perfect twins, I'd never let them endure this.

As she's feeling sad, a strong light suddenly emanates around her body and engulfs her.

NOVEL READER
(screaming in terror)
What the—?!
continuation:
INT. NOVEL WORLD - DAY

The light fades. The NOVEL READER finds herself in a simple room, wearing 1970s clothing, looking exactly like the novel's female lead JIANG NINGNING. She falls to the ground, looking bewildered.

A middle-aged woman (TIAN CUIFEN) stands in front of her, hands on hips, looking fierce.

TIAN CUIFEN
You little tramp, if our family hadn't sacrificed to send Donglin to the army, you'd have starved long ago. My daughter needs this house for her wedding. Pack your things. Tonight.

Two children (TWINS) stand not far away, looking at them fearfully.

NOVEL READER/JIANG NINGNING
(confused)
Where is this?

She looks around and sees a calendar on the wall that reads "1976".

NOVEL READER/JIANG NINGNING
(shocked)
Nineteen seventy-six?

Her head throbs with pain as a flood of memories that don't belong to her rush into her mind.

FLASHBACK BEGINS

The scene blurs, presenting the plot from the novel.

A handsome man in military uniform (HUO DONGLIN) speaks to a woman who looks just like her (ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING).

HUO DONGLIN (V.O.)
Ningning, I'm shipping out tomorrow. I'll send my allowance home. Take care.

ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING (V.O.)
Don't worry, Donglin. I'll be a good daughter-in-law while you're gone.

NOVEL READER/JIANG NINGNING (V.O.)
(internal monologue)
Why does that woman have my face?

The scene switches. TIAN CUIFEN points at ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING'S nose and scolds her.

TIAN CUIFEN (V.O.)
An orphan brings nothing to this family. If Donglin weren't twenty-seven, we'd never have taken you. His allowance comes to me. Every single yuan.

A young girl (HUO CHUNFANG) steps on ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING'S hand with her foot.

HUO CHUNFANG (V.O.)
Watch yourself while my brother's gone, sister-in-law. No one likes a pretty widow.

The scene switches again. ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING has given birth to twins.

MIDWIFE (V.O.)
Twins! Madam Huo, your family's doubled its fortune!

HUO CHUNFANG gossips behind ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING'S back.

HUO CHUNFANG (V.O.)
Donglin's been gone a year and a half. Those aren't his children.

TIAN CUIFEN forces the weak ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING, who just gave birth, to get out of bed and write a letter.

TIAN CUIFEN (V.O.)
Up! Write to Donglin! Tell him about the twins and demand more money! Now!

ORIGINAL JIANG NINGNING lies on the table, tears in her eyes.

The history books mentioned a sister-in-law and nephew. These must be them.

Xie Jian let it slip? The grand villain who does everything flawlessly?

QI TIAN (30s), black battle armor slick with rain, cuts through a horde of enemies. Steel flashes. Lightning illuminates the carnage.

They called him the Dragon Lord. In one night, ten million fell. By dawn, the four seas belonged to Great Xia. Then... he vanished.

QI TIAN, white tank top and worn trousers, splits a watermelon with a single stroke. Beside him, a faded flag bearing the character "Dragon" flutters lazily.

A group of PEDESTRIANS approach.

QI TIAN
Dragon melons. Hundred thousand a pound. Guaranteed sweet.

PEDESTRIAN A
Hundred thousand? For fruit? You cracked?

PEDESTRIAN B
Guy's a nutter. Let's go.

WANG JINSONG
(bowing low)
Forgive the intrusion, Dragon Lord. That flag... I've been searching three months.

QI TIAN
(without looking up)
You found me. Now what?

WANG JINSONG
Your wife's company—her new medicine. The approvals are... expedited. She'll have them by dawn.

Qi Tian's knife pauses mid-slice. He glances at a simple silver ring on his finger.

QI TIAN
What do you want?

A Bodyguard steps forward with a velvet tray bearing an antique key and a black card. Wang waves the card away.

WANG JINSONG
The Cloud Province Villa. Key's yours. For one melon.

QI TIAN
A villa for fruit? You're overpaying.

WANG JINSONG
I'm paying what it's worth to me.

QI TIAN
(takes the key, hefts it)
Protection doesn't come this cheap.

WANG JINSONG
(hastily)
The card holds a hundred million. For... expenses.

Qi Tian pockets both, selects a perfect melon.

QI TIAN
You're under Dragon Gate's roof now. Don't make me regret it.

WANG JINSONG
(gravely)
continuation:
Thank you, Dragon Lord.

The Bodyguard reveals a glass case containing a Tianshan snow lotus.

WANG JINSONG
For your wife's research. A token.

Qi Tian accepts it with surprising gentleness, wrapping it in clean cloth before placing it beneath the stand.

QI TIAN
You're thorough. We're done.

WANG JINSONG
Yes, Dragon Lord.

They retreat backwards, heads bowed.

A WOMAN in a red halter top materializes from the shadows. Qi Tian's knife flashes to her throat in one motion.

QI TIAN
I'm retired.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
Sir. Your wife—

QI TIAN
(lowering the blade)
What about her?

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
The five hundred million is gone. Her drug failed. Zero sales.

Qi Tian selects a melon slice, studies it.

QI TIAN
Buy every unit. Five billion. Anonymously.

FEMALE SUBORDINATE
She'll suspect.

QI TIAN
Let her think she's brilliant. Let her win.

She nods, vanishing as silently as she came.

A red Ferrari roars up. LIU RUYAN (20s), white designer dress, steps out with an imperious bearing.

LIU RUYAN
Qi Tian.

He bites into a rind, unimpressed.

QI TIAN
You're blocking my sun.

LIU RUYAN
My father... Zongheng Group. He said you owed him a promise.

QI TIAN
Old Liu's girl. I owe no one.

LIU RUYAN
(smiling coldly)
Then why did you send him a jade pendant when I was born? With a vow.

QI TIAN
(still)
That was before.

LIU RUYAN
I'm here to collect. The vow was for marriage.

OLD GU looks at a photo of a girl. The girl in the photo is demure and poised.

OLD GU
Acceptable. She knows her angles.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(relieved)
She's been groomed for this alliance since childhood.

Suddenly, TANG NUANNUAN appears in the doorway. She sports a neon-pink wig, a clashing floral jacket, and holds a comically oversized lollipop. She swaggers toward them.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(horrified)
Miss, you've mistaken this pavilion for the costume party.

TANG NUANNUAN
(defiantly)
Cut the act, Dad. I'm your three o'clock.

OLD GU
(intrigued)
Remarkable. You share minimal DNA with this photograph.

TANG NUANNUAN
That's Photoshop for you. The photo's my highlight reel.

continuation:
TANG NUANNUAN
Not terrible. Still not worth my freedom.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(to OLD GU, desperate)
Obviously this performance voids our agreement. We'll triple your compensation—

CHAIRMAN TANG stands up, trying to pull TANG NUANNUAN away.

CHAIRMAN TANG
(hissing)
You've ruined us!

(standing up, stopping them)
Wait. I find her... authentic. August 15th stands.

(stunned)
What?

GU CHENYU, a sharp-featured man in his thirties, swings a golf club.

President Gu, Old Master Gu confirmed the wedding. He said: "She has spine."

(expressionless)
Did she now.

INT. ARCHAEOLOGICAL SITE - DAY

XU JIPING, wearing blue work clothes, extracts a wooden box from the muddy earth with trembling care. He cracks the lid.

XU JIPING
(to himself)
Xia burial goods, but the context is impossible. Unless—

The jade flares. Light engulfs him. He disappears. The box drops into the mud.

XU JIPING lies on a bed, eyes closed, wrists loosely bound. CHU XIANGXIANG stands over an overturned wine service. Two HANDMAIDENS huddle near the door.

HANDMAIDEN
(whispering)
Miss Chu, the physician swore it was only enough to flush him from your chambers. Not... fatal.

CHU XIANGXIANG
(quiet, fierce)
The wastrel's constitution proved weaker than I calculated.

XU JIPING's eyes snap open. He focuses on Chu Xiangxiang. She goes pale.

XU JIPING
Where— Who bound me—
continuation:
He sits up. The poorly-tied cords slip free. The handmaidens stare.

HANDMAIDEN
His mind... it must have broken.

XU JIPING
(touching his temples)
Hallucination. Possible toxin. Cultural disorientation—

A memory surfaces: HIMSELF—this body—leaping from behind a pillar, spilling Chu Xiangxiang's pastries. Her humiliated fury.

XU JIPING
(realization)
Chu Xiangxiang. I've... I've time-traveled.

His legs buckle. The aphrodisiac's heat floods his veins. He stumbles toward the table for water, but collides with Chu Xiangxiang. They fall back onto the bed.

CHU XIANGXIANG
(struggling)
Get off—stop—

The door explodes open. FATHER CHU charges in, sword bared.

FATHER CHU
(roaring)
Defile my daughter, you diseased goat? I'll send you to your ancestors!

He slashes. Xu Jiping—pure instinct—whips the silk cord around the blade, yanking it off-course. The sword buries in a floorboard. Both stare, stunned.

Description: A man imprisoned and betrayed by his wife and her lover is sold to an underground entertainment venue where he is tortured for the audience's amusement while forced to witness his wife's betrayal.

INT. BLACK DOMAIN SHOWROOM - NIGHT

MONTAGE - NIGHTSCAPE
Fast cuts: Rain-slicked streets, flickering neon kanji, a towering megastructure in the distance labeled "TOWER-7 SECURITY FACILITY." Camera pushes through a steel door into a pulsing underground showroom.

SHOWROOM HOST (30s, razor-sharp suit) grips a chrome microphone, pacing the catwalk stage.

SHOWROOM HOST
(into microphone, showman's grin)
Black Domain! Where the City's finest come to play!

He gestures to a massive holographic screen descending behind him.

SHOWROOM HOST
Tonight's special - a Tower transfer who thinks he's going home. Place your bets, ladies and gentlemen. How long until Lu Yun breaks?

The screen displays: "LU YUN - INMATE #7734" with timer options: 5 MIN / 10 MIN / 15 MIN. The capacity crowd, including SUN QIANG and ZHAO YA in a velvet booth, taps their phones. Results flash: 89% voted 5 MIN.

Two GUARDS shove LU YUN (30s, broken but defiant) onto the stage. A smart-collar blinks red around his neck. His prison uniform is torn, one eye swollen shut.

LU YUN (V.O.)
(barely a whisper)
Yaya's birthday is next week. Zhao Ya promised we'd get her that doll...

A GUARD plants a boot in Lu Yun's back.

GUARD
Move, convict!

INT. VIP ROOM - NIGHT

Behind one-way glass, SUN QIANG (40s, predator-calm) sips whiskey with ZHAO YA (30s, brittle elegance). She watches Lu Yun on a monitor, knuckles white on her clutch.

LU YAYA (6, pigtails) bursts in, clutching a crayon drawing.

LU YAYA
Mommy, look! I drew Daddy!

ZHAO YA
(flinching, then cold)
Not now, Yaya.

She sets the child on the floor a bit too firmly. Yaya's lip trembles.

SUN QIANG
(eyes on Zhao Ya, not the child)
They say a hundred days of marriage builds grace. You Jiang City women are... efficient.

He traces Zhao Ya's jawline. She doesn't pull away.

SUN QIANG
Sent him to prison. Sold his sentence to us. What's next?

ZHAO YA
(tight smile)
Young Master Sun, that transfer fee bought this room. Consider it... entertainment insurance.

She kisses his knuckles. He catches her wrist.

SUN QIANG
Then let's make sure he gets his money's worth.

LU YAYA
(small voice)
Mommy, why are you with the bad man?

ZHAO YA
(eyes flashing, then dead)
He's not bad, baby. He's just... winning.
continuation:
INT. BLUE ROOM - NIGHT

Lu Yun is shoved into a sapphire-lit chamber, walls dripping with condensation. Steel drains line the floor.

GUARD
In you go!

Lu Yun stumbles. His hands touch the cold metal. He looks up.

LU YUN
This isn't the transfer bus...

A ONE-EYED MAN (50s, scarred, silver canine tooth) emerges from shadow. His eyepatch is etched with a barcode.

ONE-EYED MAN
Daxia Tower breeds soft men. Lucky for us.

He seizes Lu Yun's throat. Two BULL-MASKED ATTENDANTS pin his arms.

LU YUN
(choking)
Sun Qiang's testimony... already got me five years...

ONE-EYED MAN
(leaning in, whisper)
This isn't prison, pretty boy. This is premium content. And your wife? She's a producer now.

He forces Lu Yun to his knees facing a glass wall.

ONE-EYED MAN
The good viewers of Channel Black want their finale. Kneel for camera three.

INT. VIP ROOM - NIGHT

Sun Qiang taps a remote. The glass wall between rooms clears. Zhao Ya inhales sharply.

INT. BLUE ROOM - NIGHT

Lu Yun sees them. His wife. The man who framed him. Behind the glass, untouchable.

LU YUN
(anguished howl)
Zhao Ya! You said it was a conjugal visit!

Sun Qiang's voice crackles through a speaker.

SUN QIANG (O.S.)
She lied. Shocking, I know.

He hauls Lu Yaya up to the glass. The child's face presses against it.

LU YAYA
Daddy!

ZHAO YA
(on the phone, voice honeyed)
Honey, tell him what you told me. About the money.

LU YUN
(shattered)
You sold my sentence... for a fucking VIP room?

SUN QIANG
Through the glass, he mimes a kiss at Zhao Ya. She takes the gesture, but her reflection shows a tear she won't let him see.

ZHAO YA
(into phone, breaking)
I'm his secretary now. Yaya needs a future.

SUN QIANG
(to Yaya, gentle)
Your daddy's going to sing for us. Isn't that nice?

He puts Yaya down. She runs to Zhao Ya, who turns away.

LU YUN
(screaming, to Zhao Ya)
You look at her! LOOK AT HER!

ONE-EYED MAN
(pressing a blade to Lu Yun's ear)
She's looking at her new life. Now... let's give them a show.

The smart-collar injects something. Lu Yun's body goes rigid. The One-Eyed Man whispers:

ONE-EYED MAN
Your daughter gets to watch you cry. Family entertainment.

FADE OUT.

Jingshen!

Description: A humble temple janitor reveals his hidden strength when confronted by arrogant visitors before a martial arts trial assembly.

TITLE CARD: WUDAO MOUNTAIN WUJI TEMPLE

EXT. TEMPLE MOUNTAIN GATE - DAY

A black sedan stops at the bottom of a long stone staircase. Several BODYGUARDS exit the car and open an umbrella for an elegant woman in a black dress (QIN RUOYU).

QIN RUOYU walks briskly up the stone steps in high heels.

On the steps, a young man in simple white clothing (YE QINGYUN) is lying down sleeping, with a broom and a pile of swept leaves beside him.

QIN RUOYU
Ye Qingyun?

YE QINGYUN opens his eyes—not lazy, but assessing.

YE QINGYUN
You're early. The Assembly doesn't start for hours.

QIN RUOYU
The Xia family petitioned the Council. Intervene today, and you're rogue. No sect, no protection.

She places a sealed envelope beside him.

YE QINGYUN
(sitting up)
They think sweeping temples scares me?

QIN RUOYU
They think losing your name terrifies you.

She continues up the mountain. Ye Qingyun watches her, then glances at the envelope—his name written in the hand of his former master. He tucks it away.

An arrogant man in a floral shirt (FLORAL SHIRT MAN) approaches with two HENCHMEN.

FLORAL SHIRT MAN
(pointing at the leaf pile)
Who piles garbage here?

YE QINGYUN
(standing)
I do. Problem?

HENCHMAN A
Apologize to my boss!

FLORAL SHIRT MAN
(laughing)
Wait... I know you. The Xia family's useless son-in-law. Come to hide?

YE QINGYUN
I don't hide. I wait.

FLORAL SHIRT MAN
Wait for what? More humiliation?

He kicks the leaf pile apart. The HENCHMEN move to grab Ye Qingyun.

FLORAL SHIRT MAN
The four great families are up there. Even the Commander came to watch. A sweeper like you—
continuation:
YE QINGYUN
If the Commander breaks something, he pays for it.

FLORAL SHIRT MAN
You stinking sweeper, how dare you—

YE QINGYUN
If you break something, you pay.

FLORAL SHIRT MAN kicks at him. Ye Qingyun catches his ankle and dumps him into his own scattered leaves.

HENCHMAN B
He used internal energy! He's not crippled!

FLORAL SHIRT MAN
(struggling up)
Tiger Lord will kill you!

YE QINGYUN
Then bring him.

A booming voice echoes.

TIGER LORD (O.S.)
Who dares?

A burly man in black robes (TIGER LORD) leads a dozen men down the stairs. He stops, staring at Ye Qingyun.

TIGER LORD
You healed.

YE QINGYUN
I buried what needed burying.

TIGER LORD
The Council thinks you're neutral. But if you can fight, you're a contender. That changes the vote.

YE QINGYUN
I don't vote.

TIGER LORD
Then why test your strength here? Why now?

Ye Qingyun's gaze drifts past Tiger Lord—toward the temple, toward where Qin Ruoyu vanished. He smiles faintly.

YE QINGYUN
Someone has to clean the garbage.

TIGER LORD
(smiling coldly)
The Xia family sent her to warn you off. Smart.

He steps closer, menace rising.

TIGER LORD
But you're going to defy them. Because that's what you do.

YE QINGYUN
And you're going to get in my way. Because that's what you do.

TIGER LORD
You're asking for death!

YE QINGYUN emanates an invisible aura of power, staring coldly at TIGER LORD and his men.

INT. OFFICE - DAY

YE XI (27, composed but with fraying patience) holds a leave request form. Her boss, MR. CHEN, never looks up from his monitor.

YE XI
Mr. Chen, I've submitted this three times.

MR. CHEN
And I've ignored it three times. We're finalizing the Q4 report. Everyone stays.

YE XI
(quietly)
My grandfather's turning ninety. He thinks I'm bringing someone home.

MR. CHEN
(typing)
Your personal life doesn't pay your bonus. Welcome to corporate reality.

His phone BUZZES. He reaches for it instinctively, catching the name "WIFE" on screen. He angles away, but Ye Xi sees.

MR. CHEN
(sotto voce, into phone)
Hey, sweetheart... Yes, I'll make the reunion dinner... No, work won't keep me this year.

Ye Xi's expression shifts from resignation to calculation.

YE XI
(loudly, to herself)
Corporate reality, right.

She clicks her phone's voice memo app, holds it up.

YE XI
(to the room)
Just want to document this motivational moment. Mr. Chen confirming that family comes second to productivity.

MR. CHEN
(hand over phone)
What are you—

YE XI
Affects everyone, doesn't it? Or does policy only apply when your wife's not calling?

MR. CHEN
(frantic, to phone)
It's not what it sounds like—

YE XI
(to the office)
I've canceled three trips home. Worked eighty-hour weeks. My grandfather's crying when I call.

Turns to leave, pauses at the door.

YE XI
You're right about one thing. I won't find life value here.

She drops her access card on the reception desk. The whole office watches.

MR. CHEN
(into phone, desperate)
No, no, I was telling them to work harder, not me—

YE XI
Tell your wife I said happy new year.
continuation:
INT. COFFEE SHOP - DAY

YE XI hurries in, checks her phone: 3:47. Half an hour late. Her confident mask slips—she's genuinely flustered.

She scans the room: GRAY COAT, BEIGE SCARF—yes, there. But the man is already watching her, like he knew she'd be late.

YE XI
(hovering)
Gu Li?

GU LI
You texted you'd be twenty minutes. You were optimistic.

YE XI
(fumbling)
The meeting ran... no. I quit my job. It was... loud.

GU LI
(slight smile)
So I gathered. You're shaking.

YE XI
(hands in pockets)
It's nothing. You're ready, right? We have the contract—

GU LI
The basics. Pretend we're dating. Endure three days of family interrogation. Don't embarrass you.

Exactly. Five thousand, as agreed.

GU LI
You should know: I'm expensive at pretending. But when I commit, I'm convincing.

YE XI
That's... what I need.

Then let's rewrite the terms.

GU LI
A boyfriend wouldn't let you freeze. And he'd know your grandfather's favorite tea.

YE XI
(pause)
Pu'er. The aged kind.

GU LI
Good. Now we have somewhere to start.

description: A nurse saves a man being chased by thugs in an underground parking garage, only to discover he's been poisoned and is searching for her.
context:
Title: Dangerous Encounter
Description: A nurse saves a man being chased by thugs in an underground parking garage, only to discover he's been poisoned and is searching for her.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - NIGHT

Female nurse LI RONGYUE walks toward her car while talking on the phone.

LI RONGYUE
(on phone)
Don't worry, just enjoy your date with your rich boyfriend.

A man in black, PEI HENG, stumbles from behind a pillar, his movements labored.

LI RONGYUE
(on phone)
No one noticed I covered your shift.

As LI RONGYUE reaches for her car door, PEI HENG lunges forward, muffling her startled cry and pulling her behind the vehicle.

LI RONGYUE
(terrified, muffled)
Hey! Ahhh!

PEI HENG fumbles with the back door, urgency in his trembling hands.

Three THUGS holding clubs and knives rush into the parking garage.

INT. CAR - CONTINUOUS

PEI HENG collapses against LI RONGYUE, his hand gently but firmly covering her mouth, his breathing ragged.

LI RONGYUE
(struggling, muffled)
Ahhh!

PEI HENG
(whispering, desperate)
Please... be quiet. They'll kill us both.

LI RONGYUE's eyes widen in recognition, then steel with resolve.

LI RONGYUE
(inner monologue)
That face... from the news? The missing CEO?

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - CONTINUOUS

The LEAD THUG and his two lackeys scan the area, their footsteps echoing.

LEAD THUG
Damn it! He can't be far, not with that poison in his system. Split up!

INT. CAR - CONTINUOUS

PEI HENG's grip loosens as his strength fades.

PEI HENG
(whisper fading)
Don't... move.

LI RONGYUE watches the thugs approach, her medical training warring with her fear.

LI RONGYUE
(inner monologue)
His pulse is erratic. He's dying.

LI RONGYUE grabs PEI HENG's wrist, pressing her thumb urgently to his radial pulse.

LI RONGYUE
(aloud, firm)
Stay with me.

She shifts abruptly, leaning out the window with calculated annoyance.

LI RONGYUE
(shouting at the thugs)
Excuse me! Do you mind? Some of us are trying to have a private moment here!

The THUGS freeze, caught off guard.

LI RONGYUE turns back to PEI HENG, her voice dropping to a honeyed whisper.

LI RONGYUE
Hold on, love. I'll get rid of them.

She leans out again, brandishing her hospital ID.

LI RONGYUE
I'm a nurse, and this is my break. You want me filing a harassment report?

LEAD THUG
(stammering)
We... we didn't realize—

LI RONGYUE
Then keep walking!

The THUGS retreat, glancing back suspiciously.

Li Rongyue slumps back inside, sealing the doors. She turns to PEI HENG, now convulsing gently.

LI RONGYUE
What's in your system? How much time?

PEI HENG
(voice cracking)
Need... hospital. But they'll be watching.

His hand clutches hers, accidentally snagging her necklace.

LI RONGYUE
My necklace—

The chain breaks. PEI HENG collapses against her shoulder, unconscious.
continuation:
INT. CAR - LATER

LI RONGYUE sits alone in the back seat, her uniform disheveled, clutching her broken chain.

PEI HENG (V.O.)
I will find you.

LI RONGYUE exits the car. A ruby pendant lies on the seat.

PEI HENG's fingers close around it as consciousness returns.

CLOSE-UP: LI RONGYUE's ID badge, reading "Name: Li Rongyue, Position: Emergency Nurse, Number: H027."

CLOSE-UP of PEI HENG's face, his eyes burning with grim determination.

INT. UNDERGROUND PARKING GARAGE - LATER

PEI HENG leans against the car, weak but upright. Three SUBORDINATES in suits approach with medical equipment.

SUBORDINATE
Young Master Pei, your security detail failed. The antidote—

PEI HENG
(cutting him off)
Find the woman who saved me. She dropped this.

He holds up the ruby pendant.

PEI HENG
She's about 5'4", mid-twenties, works at Central Hospital. And she risked her life for a stranger.

SUBORDINATE
We'll have her located within the hour.

PEI HENG
Bring her to me safely. And find out who poisoned me.

FLASHBACK

INT. HOSPITAL LOCKER ROOM - DAY

LI RONGYUE sits on a bench, examining her broken necklace chain. The ruby pendant is missing. A COLLEAGUE NURSE enters.

COLLEAGUE NURSE
You okay? You look exhausted.

LI RONGYUE
(carefully)
Long shift. Thought I lost something important.

She touches her bare neck.

LI RONGYUE
Turns out I did.

COLLEAGUE NURSE
Director needs you in trauma bay two. Possible poisoning case.

LI RONGYUE stands, her expression hardening with recognition.

LI RONGYUE
I'm on my way.

title: Prosperous Blossoms
description: A modern finance student is electrocuted and transported into an ancient dynasty, where he wakes up in the empress's bed, facing the same fate as his historical namesake.
context:
Title: Prosperous Blossoms
Description: A modern finance student is electrocuted and transported into an ancient dynasty, where he wakes up in the empress's bed, facing the same fate as his historical namesake.

INT. APARTMENT - DAY

XIAO QIAN and his GIRLFRIEND are passionately kissing against the wall. She pulls back, breathless.

GIRLFRIEND
Shower first. You're vibrating with caffeine.

XIAO QIAN
That's just market excitement. Made three hundred on the yuan dip.

XIAO QIAN
Wait for me.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

GIRLFRIEND towel-dries her hair, picks up an ancient book from the study materials. She reads aloud.

GIRLFRIEND
(sardonic)
"Xiao Qian of the Southern Kingdom—gambled away his fortune, sold his wife into servitude, and after failing as a eunuch, was executed by five horses for touching the Emperor."

She flips the page. The book's spine crackles with static electricity.

GIRLFRIEND
(calling out)
Your father sent another "educational" text. This guy's supposedly our ancestor?
continuation:
INT. BATHROOM - DAY

XIAO QIAN wipes steam from the mirror, sees the CURLING IRON dangling near the sink edge—unplugged but still hot.

XIAO QIAN
(to himself)
Risk assessment: high. Reward: none.

He reaches to move it safely away. His wet hand touches the metal.

A neon-blue current erupts—not from the iron, but from the ANCIENT BOOK in the other room, channeling through the apartment's wiring.

XIAO QIAN's body seizes. The mirror cracks, spiderwebbing from his reflection.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

GIRLFRIEND sees blue light bleeding under the bathroom door. She drops the book.

GIRLFRIEND
Xiao Qian!

The book flares. Pages fly, whipping into a vortex.

MONTAGE

Blue lightning becomes silk threads. The apartment's modern grid morphs into ancient constellations. "Southern Kingdom" appears in elegant calligraphy across a dawn sky.

INT. ANCIENT PALACE BEDCHAMBER - DAWN

XIAO QIAN gasps awake. Silk sheets. Sandalwood and wine. His hands clutch brocade.

He turns. Beside him, the EMPRESS sleeps with a dagger under her pillow.

XIAO QIAN
(whisper)
No... no, no, no...

He checks his body—intact. Then spots his reflection: he's wearing a EUNUCH'S UNIFORM.

XIAO QIAN
(voice cracking)
I'm the eunuch. The one who—

The Empress stirs. Xiao Qian freezes. His hand brushes her ankle.

The Empress's eyes snap open. Her hand goes for the dagger.

EMPRESS
(low, dangerous)
Another one who wants to die before sunrise?

XIAO QIAN
Your Majesty, I—I tripped on history!

VOICE (O.S.)
Urgent news! The Emperor approaches!

The Empress's gaze doesn't leave Xiao Qian. She smiles, thin and terrible.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: The World's Wealth Emperor
description: The most powerful and wealthy man in the land holds the fate of kingdoms in his hands as kings compete for his fortune.
context:
Title: The World's Wealth Emperor
Description: The most powerful and wealthy man in the land holds the fate of kingdoms in his hands as kings compete for his fortune.

EXT. ANCIENT COURTYARD - DAY

SOUND of intense fighting.

Several KINGS wearing distinct royal robes sit in chairs watching the battle. In the center of the courtyard, ASURA WAR GOD wields a battle axe, fighting fiercely against armored training dummies. He moves with precision, each strike sending sparks flying.

SUPER: King of Dasi Kingdom

SUPER: Asura War God - Great Xia's Invincible Champion

ASURA WAR GOD
You are no match for this War God.

QINGTIAN WAR GOD holds a sword, confronting ASURA WAR GOD.

SUPER: Qingtian War God - Great Lin's Final Hope

QINGTIAN WAR GOD
Don't be arrogant! The Wealth Emperor's bounty must save Great Lin Kingdom! Military funding issues plague us.

ASURA WAR GOD
The Wealth Emperor's reward can erase that debt.

SUPER: King of Great Lin Kingdom

KING OF GREAT LIN KINGDOM
For Great Lin Kingdom!

QINGTIAN WAR GOD
For Great Lin Kingdom, I will fight you to the death!

QINGTIAN WAR GOD brandishes his sword and charges at ASURA WAR GOD. The two begin an intense battle.

KING OF GREAT LIN KINGDOM
Qingtian War God, Asura War God, win this and our debt to the Wealth Emperor is erased. I'm counting on you!

The two continue fighting.

SUPER: King of Great Chen Kingdom

KING OF GREAT CHEN KINGDOM
(anxiously)
Lord Wealth Emperor, plague runs rampant in Great Chen Kingdom. Our people are displaced, dying of disease and hunger. We urgently need your aid.
continuation:
The KINGS descend from their chairs and kneel on the ground.

ALL KINGS
We beg the Wealth Emperor for mercy! We beg the Wealth Emperor for rewards!

A team of MEN IN BLACK SUITS carry several large chests into the courtyard and neatly place them on the ground. A man wearing an ornate mask and black robes—THE WEALTH EMPEROR—walks through the main gate.

ALL KINGS
(in unison)
We welcome the Wealth Emperor!

SUPER: The World's Wealth Emperor - Bian Wudao

WEALTH EMPEROR
Everyone, rise.

The KINGS stand up.

ALL KINGS
We pay our respects to the Wealth Emperor.

WEALTH EMPEROR
Your groveling entertains me. Open the chests.

The MEN IN BLACK open the chests, which are filled with imperial credits. The KINGS show expressions of surprise and greed.

WEALTH EMPEROR
Today, this Emperor grows bored of your duels. All shall be rewarded!

The WEALTH EMPEROR throws credits into the air. The KINGS kneel on the ground scrambling to collect them.

A blonde woman, LONG KUI, leaps down from the roof and lands steadily before the WEALTH EMPEROR.

SUPER: Long Kui - The Wealth Emperor's Shadow

LONG KUI
Reporting to the Wealth Emperor, the daughter of Jiang City's wealthiest man has vowed to marry only you. She has prepared a banquet and wishes to wed you before the city's elite.

WEALTH EMPEROR
Marriage? This Emperor will marry, but not her.

LONG KUI
The Wealth Emperor is the richest in the world. What woman could be worthy?

WEALTH EMPEROR
Someone, bring the Ten National Treasures and ten thousand taels of gold. Accompany this Emperor to Jiang City to present betrothal gifts. The woman this Emperor will marry is...

title: A Thought of Warmth
description: A woman destined for seven lifetimes of loneliness is granted seven soulmates in one life by the Moon God, leading to chaos at her wedding and a journey through fated love.
context:
Title: A Thought of Warmth
Description: A woman destined for seven lifetimes of loneliness is granted seven soulmates in one life by the Moon God, leading to chaos at her wedding and a journey through fated love.

EXT. WEDDING LAWN - DAY

WEN NUAN (28, elegant but hollow-eyed) walks with her FATHER toward YU HAN. Her bouquet trembles slightly.

FATHER
You're freezing.

WEN NUAN
Just nerves.

FATHER
Yu Han, I'm entrusting my daughter to you.

OFFICIANT
Mr. Yu Han, do you take Miss Wen Nuan?

YU HAN
I do.

OFFICIANT
Miss Wen Nuan, do you take Mr. Yu Han?

WEN NUAN
I...

Seven phantom threads shimmer from her fingertips, tugging toward different guests.

WEN NUAN
(voice cracking)
I object!

SEVEN OBJECTORS rise from the crowd. Each carries himself differently: a CEO, a musician, a teacher, a chef, an artist, an athlete, a scholar.

OBJECTORS
We object!

YU HAN
(steps closer, protective)
She's already chosen.

CEO OBJECTOR
Has she? Or has she simply settled for what's safe?

The seven move in, surrounding Wen Nuan. They kneel, producing rings.

OBJECTORS
Marry me. Choose me. Save me.

WEN NUAN
(backing away)
I just want one proper wedding!
continuation:
INT. MOVIE THEATER - NIGHT

Wen Nuan jerks awake in her seat. Seven crimson threads wrap her fingers, pulsing. MOON GOD (white-haired, ancient) watches the screen replay the wedding.

WEN NUAN
That wasn't a dream.

MOON GOD
Memory. Of what will be.

WEN NUAN
Seven lifetimes alone, and your solution is seven chains?

MOON GOD
I gave you what you earned. Love in abundance.

WEN NUAN
(standing)
I learned to stand without it.

MOON GOD
Then break them. The threads are yours.

He vanishes. The theater dissolves to mist.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

Wen Nuan snaps awake. She checks her fingers: seven faint red circles remain. She touches them, resigned but determined.

WEN NUAN
(whisper)
Break them.

INT. COMPANY HALLWAY - DAY

Wen Nuan sits among INTERVIEWEES, hiding her marked hand. YU HAN approaches, sizing up the room.

YU HAN
Mind if I sit?

WEN NUAN
Please.

He sits beside her. She quickly hides her marked hand.

YU HAN
Yu Han.

WEN NUAN
Wen Nuan.

They shake. For a moment, only ONE solid thread appears between them, bright and true.

INTERVIEWER (O.S.)
Wen Nuan?

She stands, takes a breath. The phantom threads tug at her fingers. She walks forward anyway, leaving them slack behind her.

FADE OUT.

title: Five Elements Legend (Episode 65)
description: At a temple, disciples train under Master Hu Shan's watchful eye when the sinister Qing Sha and his black-clad soldiers arrive at the gates.
context:
Title: Five Elements Legend (Episode 65)
Description: At a temple, disciples train under Master Hu Shan's watchful eye when the sinister Qing Sha and his black-clad soldiers arrive at the gates.

EXT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - DAY

Wide shot.

On the broad stone steps in front of the temple, DISCIPLE A and DISCIPLE B are engaged in intense sparring. MASTER HU SHAN stands nearby, holding a monk's staff, watching them sternly.

Close shot.

DISCIPLE A and DISCIPLE B wield heavy weapons, their moves sharp and fierce—A pressing forward with raw intensity, B defending with fluid precision. The clashing of their weapons rings out continuously. DISCIPLE A executes a graceful backflip and lands steadily.

MASTER HU SHAN
(to Disciple B)
Your form holds, but your conviction trembles. They will sense that.

The disciples cross their weapons in front of MASTER HU SHAN.

MASTER HU SHAN
(to both)
Good. Remember—protecting the temple means more than winning.
continuation:
EXT. MILITARY CAMP GATE - DAY

Wide shot.

A heavily guarded city gate with a plaque reading "General's Mansion." A woman in white robes walks slowly toward the gate, her hand clutching a broken sword hilt bearing the temple's insignia.

A group of black-clad soldiers kneel on one knee, holding their weapons. A black flag bearing the character "Sha" flutters in the wind.

Close-up of the unusual weapons in the soldiers' hands—obsidian blades that seem to absorb light rather than reflect it.

A man dressed in red and white robes plays with a throwing knife between his fingers, his eyes locked on the woman's pendant.

EXT. TEMPLE COURTYARD - DAY

The red temple doors are pushed open from the outside.

Outside the gate, QING SHA appears with a large group of black-clad soldiers. His armor bears the same broken-sword insignia as the woman's hilt.

Inside the courtyard, MASTER HU SHAN and his disciples maintain their defensive stance, watching the entrance warily.

DAOIST ELDER stands to the side. Seeing who has arrived, his face shows shock and bitter recognition.

DAOIST ELDER
(shocked)
Qing Sha. You traded your soul for those blades.

QING SHA enters the courtyard with a smug smile on his face, his gaze falling on the Daoist Elder.

QING SHA
Elder. You taught me that mercy is weakness. I've merely learned my lesson.

title: Time-Jumping Fried Noodle King
description: A skilled noodle vendor defends his craft and gets transported to an ancient battlefield through a mysterious portal.
context:
Title: Time-Jumping Fried Noodle King
Description: A skilled noodle vendor defends his craft and gets transported to an ancient battlefield through a mysterious portal.

INT. STREET NOODLE STALL - DAY

LIN CHE stir-fries noodles with surgical precision. A faded photo of an elderly woman watches from his cart.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Boss. One hundred servings. Nine minutes.

LIN CHE
Timer's running.

He taps his phone—an app reads "Master's Challenge: 09:00." A red envelope notification flashes.

LIN CHE puts in earbuds. Old-school hip-hop merges with the sizzle. He closes his eyes.

A VENDOR crashes into a table.

VENDOR (O.S.)
Lin! Dazhuang's coming—skipped every stall but yours!

Pedestrians evaporate. The FEMALE CUSTOMER melts into the crowd. LIN CHE doesn't flinch.

His phone BUZZES: 00:00. He slides the final portion into a box.

LIN CHE
(to the photo)
Done, Ma.

He looks up. WANG DAZHUANG and three HENCHMEN block his exit. DAZHUANG lifts the box, inhales.

WANG DAZHUANG
They call you legend.

He drops it. Noodles spray across pavement.

LIN CHE
That was my mother's recipe.

WANG DAZHUANG
Mama can't protect you now.
continuation:
LIN CHE's knuckles whiten. He exhales.

LIN CHE
She protected this neighborhood thirty years without paying parasites.

LIN CHE flips the wok—scalding oil arcs. He vaults the counter. Ladles become batons, strainer a shield, awning leverage. HENCHMEN drop. DAZHUANG crawls through noodles.

WANG DAZHUANG
(shouting)
After him!

WANG DAZHUANG and HENCHMEN scramble up. LIN CHE runs with his cart.

LIN CHE pushes. The dashboard—a jury-rigged tablet—SPOOLS with blue light. The red envelope vibrates again.

LIN CHE (V.O.)
Not now...

A PURPLE VORTEX erupts ahead. LIN CHE and cart rush in and disappear.

WANG DAZHUANG reaches the spot, stares at scorch marks.

WANG DAZHUANG
What is he?

EXT. ANCIENT BATTLEFIELD - DAY

The portal opens on a hillside. LIN CHE's cart drifts to a stop.

Below, QIN DYNASTY SOLDIERS battle SHADOW WARRIORS in black masks.

LIN CHE pokes his head out, stunned.

LIN CHE
What... what is this?

A BRIGHT LIGHT engulfs him. The takeout boxes GLOW.

LIN CHE
I'm just a cook!

FADE TO WHITE.

title: Confronting the Outrageous Sister-in-Law
description: A family faces an unexpected confrontation when a woman claims their son got her pregnant, but flashbacks reveal the demanding nature of the son's girlfriend during their first meeting.
context:
Title: Confronting the Outrageous Sister-in-Law
Description: A family faces an unexpected confrontation when a woman claims their son got her pregnant, but flashbacks reveal the demanding nature of the son's girlfriend during their first meeting.

INT. QIAO FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

Violent banging sounds come from outside the door.

BAI ZHE (O.S.)
Everyone in the Qiao family, get the hell out here!

QIAO KELAN hears the noise and walks toward the door, looking puzzled.

QIAO KELAN
Who's making such a racket?

QIAO KELAN opens the door. BAI ZHE barges in with a group of people, pushing past her.

QIAO KELAN
What do you think you're doing?

QIAO FATHER and QIAO MOTHER emerge from the inner room.

QIAO FATHER
This is private property—who are you?

BAI MOTHER walks in, followed by BAI LU, who is visibly pregnant.

BAI MOTHER
Witness this outrage! The Qiao family's son got my daughter pregnant, and now he refuses to take responsibility! What kind of monsters are you?

QIAO MOTHER turns to her son QIAO MINGWEI, who's just appeared, her face pale.

QIAO MOTHER
Mingwei... please tell me this isn't true.

QIAO MINGWEI
Mom, it's complicated—

BAI ZHE
Complicated? My sister's been carrying your child for six months while you ghosted her!

QIAO KELAN steps forward, her voice steady.

QIAO KELAN
Please, everyone, let's discuss this civilly. If my brother is truly the father, we'll do right by your family. Miss Bai—

BAI LU
(coldly)
It's Lulu. That's what Mingwei called me when we were together.

QIAO KELAN
(faint recognition crossing her face)
Lulu. Of course.

BAI MOTHER
Don't try any tricks! My daughter's reputation is ruined!

CUT TO:
continuation:
INT. QIAO FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY (FLASHBACK)

QIAO KELAN, QIAO FATHER, and QIAO MOTHER sit on the sofa in a warm atmosphere. QIAO KELAN is styling her mother's hair.

QIAO MOTHER
(smiling at her reflection)
You always make me look ten years younger.

QIAO MOTHER
Kelan, Mingwei will be here with his girlfriend any minute. Did you prepare the hongbao?

QIAO KELAN
It's ready, Mom. Your three thousand is inside, and I added more to make it ten thousand and one—symbolizing that Mingwei found a one-in-ten-thousand girl. Everything's perfect.

QIAO FATHER
You shouldn't spend your money on this.

QIAO KELAN
Dad, Mingwei is my brother. What's mine is his. It's nothing.

The door opens. QIAO MINGWEI enters with LULU, who wears a designer handbag and assesses the room with barely concealed scrutiny.

QIAO MINGWEI
Dad, Mom—this is Bai Lu. Lulu, my sister Kelan.

QIAO KELAN
(warmly extending her hand)
Lulu, Mingwei's told us so much about you.

LULU
(vague smile, ignoring the hand)
Uncle, Auntie, I've been looking forward to meeting you. Mingwei says you live in the old district?

QIAO FATHER
Please, sit down.

They sit. LULU perches on the edge of the sofa, eyeing the furniture.

QIAO MOTHER
Kelan, the gift.

QIAO KELAN
Of course.

QIAO KELAN hands the red envelope to her mother.

QIAO MOTHER
(presenting it to LULU)
Lulu, a small token. We hope you'll feel welcomed into our family.

LULU accepts the envelope, feeling its weight. Her smile vanishes. She sets it on the table untouched.

LULU
(quietly, to MINGWEI)
Mingwei, did I do something wrong?

QIAO MINGWEI
What? No, why?

LULU
(tears welling)
Then why this... this insult? Back home, a first meeting gift starts at eighty-eight thousand. How can I show my face?

QIAO MOTHER
Eighty-eight—?

QIAO KELAN
(gently)
Lulu, customs vary. That's nearly a bride price in our city. Perhaps there's been a misunderstanding.

LULU
(standing)
There's no misunderstanding. Either your family respects me, or... or we have nothing more to discuss.

She heads toward the door. QIAO MINGWEI scrambles after her.

CUT TO:

INT. QIAO FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

QIAO KELAN faces BAI LU, recognition hardening into resolve.

QIAO KELAN
Lulu, I remember now. And I remember you walked out that day over money. Before we discuss "responsibility," let's discuss paternity tests and why a woman who demanded eighty-eight thousand to exist in our lives is now demanding entry.

BAI LU's face drains of color. BAI ZHE looks between them, confused.

BAI ZHE
What are you talking about?

QIAO KELAN
I'm talking about a pattern. You want Qiao family money? You'll get Qiao family justice first.

QIAO MOTHER
Kelan's right. We Qiaos take responsibility—but not for lies.

BAI LU
(quietly)
The baby is Mingwei's. I swear—

QIAO KELAN
Then you'll have no objection to proving it. And to explaining why you disappeared for six months only to return with demands.

She pulls out her phone.

QIAO KELAN
Shall I call the hospital, or would you prefer to leave peacefully?

The silence stretches. BAI LU's hands tremble on her belly.

BAI LU
(whispering)
I... I need to think.

She turns and hurries out, her family following. The door slams. QIAO KELAN turns to her shell-shocked family.

QIAO KELAN
Mom, Dad, Mingwei—whatever this is, we'll face it together. But on our terms.

She puts a steadying hand on MINGWEI's shoulder as we—

FADE OUT.

title: Good Deeds Bring Blessings
description: A family celebrates their daughter's scientific achievement, but a relative tries to take advantage of a home renovation opportunity.
context:
Title: Good Deeds Bring Blessings
Description: A family celebrates their daughter's scientific achievement, but a relative tries to take advantage of a home renovation opportunity.

INT. SU FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

The muted television flickers. SU JIARONG's reflection shows in the dark screen—he's not watching.

NEWS ANCHOR (V.O.)
...Academician Su Yi'an's anti-cancer vaccine breakthrough. She departs tomorrow for Stockholm's Royal Academy...

SONG MINGZHU squeezes her daughter's hand, thumb tracing the calluses there.

SONG MINGZHU
Ten years in that lab. Finally, the world sees what I've always known.

The front door cracks open. SECRETARY SU MEILING slips through, holding a leather folder like a newborn.

SU MEILING
Chairman. Jinxiu Huating No. 1's deed transfer—finalized.

She sets the folder on the coffee table. Exits without waiting for acknowledgment.

SONG MINGZHU
(to Yi'an)
A place worth coming home to. After you've given so much.

SU YI'AN opens it. Her name on the deed. She closes it quickly—embarrassed by the wealth.

SU YI'AN
Mom, you didn't have to—

SU JIARONG
(eyes still on the dead screen)
Let your dad handle the renovation. Junhui called again yesterday. He's struggling.

SONG MINGZHU
Junhui? Last I heard, he couldn't tell marble from laminate.

SU JIARONG
He'll hire proper contractors. But the commission stays in family. That matters.

SU YI'AN
Dad, every forum I read says the same thing: "Never hire relatives." They'll cut corners because you'll "understand."

SONG MINGZHU
She's right. Call it what it is—charity disguised as business.

SU JIARONG's jaw tightens. He stands, walks to the window.

SU JIARONG
Fine. Your house. Your rules.

The suitcase wheels hum against tile. SONG MINGZHU kisses her husband's cheek—he doesn't turn.

SONG MINGZHU
(car door closing O.S.)
Text when you land.

The door swings shut. Silence hums.

A silhouette fills the doorway—WANG GUILAN, clutching a phone.
continuation:
WANG GUILAN
Jiarong! Junhui's crew is on standby. When do we start the demolition?

SU JIARONG spins. Guilt flashing, then something harder.

SU JIARONG
I told you—wait until my daughter left.

WANG GUILAN
(stepping inside)
She's your daughter. She'll do what you say.

SU JIARONG
This house is Mingzhu's gift. Not mine to give away.

WANG GUILAN
(phone screen glowing)
Funny. Yesterday you said a man's got to provide for his own bloodline.

She taps the screen. A voice memo plays—SU JIARONG's voice, slurred:

SU JIARONG (V.O.)
The renovation's yours. Yi'an doesn't need to know till it's done.

She smiles. Not friendly.

WANG GUILAN
So. Do we start Monday, or do I show Mingzhu how "reliable" her husband's promises are?

SU JIARONG stares at her. Then at the deed on the table. His daughter's name. His wife's power.

He reaches for his wallet. Counts out bills. The gesture humiliates him.

SU JIARONG
Five thousand. Advance.

WANG GUILAN
(laughing)
For a luxury villa? That's not even gas money for the crew.

SU JIARONG adds more. And more. Until his wallet is empty.

WANG GUILAN
(satisfied)
See? Family's always easiest to work with.

She pockets the cash. As she exits, her phone rings. She answers:

WANG GUILAN
Junhui? Start sourcing materials. And don't cheap out—we need this to look expensive.

The door closes. SU JIARONG stands alone, watching the news replay his daughter's achievement. The ticker scrolls: "Scientist's breakthrough saves millions."

He picks up the deed. Holds it to the light. His name appears nowhere—not on the house, not on her vaccine, not in her future.

The phone buzzes. A text from SONG MINGZHU: "Forgot to mention—security cameras were installed last week. App on your phone. Check vault footage."

SU JIARONG's thumb hovers over the app icon. Freezes.

FADE OUT.

title: The Pampered Junior Sister is Actually a Big Shot
description: Jiang Ruyi, the heir of the Divine Doctor, possesses extraordinary medical skills and hidden wealth. After being tricked by her master into descending the mountain, she becomes entangled with the injured CEO Fu Sinian.
context:
Title: The Pampered Junior Sister is Actually a Big Shot
Description: Jiang Ruyi, the heir of the Divine Doctor, possesses extraordinary medical skills and hidden wealth. After being tricked by her master into descending the mountain, she becomes entangled with the injured CEO Fu Sinian.

INT. MOUNTAIN COURTYARD - DAY

Dried herbs hang from rafters. JIANG RUYI (20s), plain robes, fingers a sprig of ginseng while studying a laptop screen. She sets it down and spreads a white cloth.

Her MASTER (70s, white beard) sleeps on a bamboo couch. Jiang Ruyi produces a silver needle.

She inserts the needle into his neck acupoint.

MASTER
(jolting awake)
The roast chicken—I mean, oh no!

JIANG RUYI
(calmly)
Neck's mobile now. Stop faking.

Master rotates his neck, then springs up with surprising agility.

MASTER
(gleeful)
Finally! That rheumatism had me sleeping like the dead. Heh.

He shuffles toward the laptop. Jiang Ruyi flicks a hairpin. It pins his sleeve to the doorpost. Master yanks free, sheepish.

MASTER
Mid-Autumn's coming. Your mother's family... they sent this.

He tosses her a gray cloth bundle. Inside: a folder labeled "Dingtian Pharmaceutical Group - Inheritance Claim."
continuation:
INT. MOUNTAIN COURTYARD - CONTINUOUS

Jiang Ruyi opens the folder. Her expression hardens.

JIANG RUYI
(quietly)
Father's company...

MASTER
(singsong)
Best deliver it in person!

She looks up, suspicious. A qi formation glows beneath her feet—Master's doing. She vanishes. The folder flutters down. Master catches it, his grin fading to worry.

MASTER
(mutters)
Better down there than hunted up here...

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

FU SINIAN (30s, blood-soaked shirt) staggers, clutching his side. His ASSISTANT fights off BLACK-SUITED ASSAILANTS.

ASSISTANT
(panting)
President Fu, last one. Stay—shit!

A silver light CRASHES down. Jiang Ruyi materializes, coughing.

JIANG RUYI
That fraud used the mountain's teleportation array—

ASSISTANT
Whoever you are, stand down!

Jiang Ruyi turns. Fu Sinian lunges, seizing her from behind. His grip trembles.

FU SINIAN
(to Assistant)
Hostage. Stand back.

JIANG RUYI
(still)
Your lung is perforated. Six minutes until collapse.

Fu Sinian's arm slackens. She doesn't resist.

INT. COURTYARD - DAY

FLASHBACK: Young Jiang Ruyi (8) watches her father sign papers. He presses a jade pendant into her palm.

FATHER
(young Ruyi's memory)
Protect this, Ruyi. It's the key to everything.

The pendant matches a logo on the Dingtian folder.

EXT. FOREST - NIGHT

Back on Fu Sinian's bleeding arm around her throat. Jiang Ruyi touches his wrist, feeling his pulse.

JIANG RUYI
(softly)
Your qi is in chaos. Let me help, or you'll die before your rescue arrives.

The Assistant hesitates. Fu Sinian's vision blurs. Jiang Ruyi catches him as he collapses.
