title: The Female CEO's Personal General
description: A capable CEO meets a mysterious amnesiac general disguised as a beggar, who demonstrates extraordinary combat skills when she is threatened by thugs.
context:
Title: The Female CEO's Personal General
Description: A capable CEO meets a mysterious amnesiac general disguised as a beggar, who demonstrates extraordinary combat skills when she is threatened by thugs.

EXT. COMPANY BUILDING STAIRWAY - DAY

QIAO WEIRAN, sharp-suited and visibly stressed, walks down the exterior stairway outside her corporate headquarters. Subtitle introduction: QIAO WEIRAN, President of Qiao Group.

Her phone screen glows with her father's face—SONG ZHIGUO, apoplectic.

SONG ZHIGUO (V.O.)
Qiao Weiran, get back here this instant!

QIAO WEIRAN stops. At the bottom of the stairs sits YE FENG, mid-30s, his tattered clothes belying a soldier's posture. Subtitle introduction: YE FENG, Amnesiac National Guardian General.

QIAO WEIRAN
(into phone)
Why should I? I'm president of Qiao Group. My decisions are mine alone.

SONG ZHIGUO
On what grounds? I'm still chairman! Hongyuan Group is worth billions. If you sign with Chen Tech, you're burning our future!

QIAO WEIRAN
Then watch me.

She angles her phone camera toward Ye Feng, then extracts a stack of cash from her bag. She fans the bills—letting them flutter down.

SONG ZHIGUO
You stubborn—Weiran! Weiran!

QIAO WEIRAN hangs up. A fifty-dollar bill lands on Ye Feng's lowered head.

QIAO WEIRAN
Heads up. Free money. Aren't you going to take it?

YE FENG slowly opens his eyes—alert, calculating.

YE FENG
I don't take charity. I trade value.

QIAO WEIRAN
(thinking)
A businessman beggar?

YE FENG takes the bill off his head and picks up another from the ground.

YE FENG
This covers a day's wage. For that, I'll demonstrate.

YE FENG stands up in one fluid motion.

YE FENG
Consider it a preview.

QIAO WEIRAN
(thinking)
Great. A performance artist.
continuation:
QIAO WEIRAN turns to leave.

YE FENG
Miss Qiao.

She freezes. She never told him her name.

A black van screeches to a halt. Four MEN in suits emerge—led by SCAR-FACED THUG LEADER.

THUG LEADER
Miss Qiao. Boss Wei wants a word.

QIAO WEIRAN turns back to Ye Feng.

QIAO WEIRAN
That demonstration. Can it involve breaking bones?

YE FENG
(smiles faintly)
Only if they insist.

THUG LEADER
(to Ye Feng)
Walk away, drifter. This is corporate business.

YE FENG
You're blocking the lady's path.

THUG LEADER
(laughs)
And you're blocking my patience—

YE FENG moves. A blur. His palm strikes the Leader's sternum—sends him stumbling.

THUG LEADER
Get him!

The thugs surge. Ye Feng snatches a fallen tree branch—whips it in a tight arc. Two men drop.

QIAO WEIRAN ducks behind a concrete planter.

QIAO WEIRAN
(thinking)
Holy shit.

The Thug Leader draws a knife. More men rush forward. Ye Feng spins the branch like a baton. Crack. Crack. Everyone down.

QIAO WEIRAN runs out from behind the planter.

QIAO WEIRAN
Behind you!

YE FENG whips around to see a thug with a metal pipe. The frame freezes.

FADE OUT.

title: Betrayal and Revenge
description: A once-wealthy heir, poisoned and betrayed by his lover and best friend, discovers the horrifying truth behind his terminal illness.
context:
Title: Betrayal and Revenge
Description: A once-wealthy heir, poisoned and betrayed by his lover and best friend, discovers the horrifying truth behind his terminal illness.

INT. RUNDOWN BLACK CLINIC - DAY

Thunder and lightning rage outside. A rat steals chocolate beans from a messy table.

LU HAOSHEN (30s), wearing a stained hospital gown, deathly pale and trembling, lies face down on a rusted bedframe. His fingers—once steady enough to sign million-dollar deals—struggle toward a cracked medicine bowl on the nightstand.

His hand convulses. The bowl shatters on the concrete floor. Bitter medicine pools with blood from his bleeding gums.

LU HAOSHEN rolls off the bed, crawling through the ceramic shards. He scoops the tainted residue with trembling hands, forcing it into his mouth. Blood trickles from his lips.

He moans, eyes fixed on the poison bottle on the table. He inches forward.

A pair of designer heels clicks over, crushing his fingers against the floor.

ZHAO JINGKUN (O.S.)
My God. Is that really you, Haoshen?

JI XIAOXIAO (O.S.)
Three months. You look like a corpse we forgot to bury.

JI XIAOXIAO and ZHAO JINGKUN loom over LU HAOSHEN, their reflections warped in the medicine puddle.

JI XIAOXIAO
(laughing)
Oh, this is precious.

LU HAOSHEN
(weakly)
Xiaoxiao... please. Just enough for one dose.

LU HAOSHEN
The antidote... you know the price. Xiaoxiao, for everything I gave you...

ZHAO JINGKUN kicks his hand away. LU HAOSHEN's fracture from last week screams.

LU HAOSHEN
(moaning)
Ah...!

ZHAO JINGKUN
(crouching, gripping LU HAOSHEN's jaw)
Still begging from her? After you signed over your family's shares? Your penthouse? Tell me, was it my idea or yours to make you my personal ATM?

LU HAOSHEN
(agitated)
I gave you everything. The company, the properties... You said you'd save me. Xiaoxiao, remember? When I bankrolled your 'art career'—when you needed that Taipei gallery—

JI XIAOXIAO
(kicking his ribs, precisely)
That was consulting fee. For teaching a spoiled boy to pretend he had talent. But pigs can't paint, and pigs don't get to marry their owners.

LU HAOSHEN
(desperately)
Our agreement. The transfer documents. You signed them—you promised marriage. A life together.

JI XIAOXIAO
You're a dead man walking. I'd rather burn in hell.

ZHAO JINGKUN
Let's go. The smell of failure is contagious.
continuation:
EXT. OUTSIDE CLINIC - NIGHT

Heavy rain pours. ZHAO JINGKUN hauls LU HAOSHEN by the collar, throwing him into the mud. A final kick to the spine.

LU HAOSHEN
(in pain)
Not possible... the doctors said... autoimmune...

ZHAO JINGKUN
(grabbing LU HAOSHEN's hair)
Autoimmune? Cute. Ever wonder why your 'vitamins' tasted metallic? Xiaoxiao's special thallium blend. Slow. Undetectable. Terminal. She painted the capsules herself.

FLASHBACK: Young LU HAOSHEN paints, chewing his pencil nervously. JI XIAOXIAO beside him gently corrects his grip, her smile warm. She produces a vitamin case. He swallows without looking.

LU HAOSHEN
(shocked)
The... supplements? Three years?

JI XIAOXIAO
(walking over with an umbrella, finally sincere)
I loved watching you trust me. Every morning, like a good little dog.

JI XIAOXIAO and ZHAO JINGKUN kiss—slow, deliberate, inches from LU HAOSHEN's face.

LU HAOSHEN
(heartbroken)
No... not you both. Not since—

JI XIAOXIAO
(triumphantly)
Since university. Your money bought our vacations. Our apartment. This baby.

She touches her stomach. ZHAO JINGKUN covers her hand with his.

ZHAO JINGKUN
(laughing)
Tomorrow's our wedding. Black tie. Your family chapel. We'll save you a seat—if you can crawl.

ZHAO JINGKUN and JI XIAOXIAO leave in the rain, his arm around her shoulders.

LU HAOSHEN lies in the mud, convulsing. Not from poison—from truth.

LU HAOSHEN
Ahhh—!

A red sports car hydroplanes to a stop. The door flies open. GU JIA (28, in a business suit) sprints out, phone already dialing emergency.

GU JIA
(anxiously)
Haoshen! Stay with me—stay—

GU JIA lifts LU HAOSHEN's head from the water. Her ID badge dangles: LU CORPORATION HEAD OF FORENSICS.

GU JIA
I have the lab results. I know what they did.

LU HAOSHEN's eyes focus for the first time in months. He sees her. He sees everything.

LU HAOSHEN loses consciousness as sirens wail in the distance.

title: The Delicate County Magistrate Enters Your Embrace

context:
Title: The Delicate County Magistrate Enters Your Embrace
Description: An emperor in disguise travels to Peach Blossom County and encounters a mysterious modern woman who has become the county magistrate.

EXT. PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY OUTSKIRTS - DAY

A carriage creaks along a dusty path beneath weathered ramparts.

The carriage passes through the city gate, where a wooden sign reads "PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY."

EXT. PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY STREET - DAY

The carriage halts amid market chaos. Vendors shout. Children scatter.

XIAO LIZI (O.S.)
Your Majesty...

XIAO LIZI jumps down, dusting his sleeves as he approaches the cabin.

XIAO LIZI
We've reached Peach Blossom County. The Empress Dowager's envoys won't find you here.

FANG SHANG (late 20s, regal bearing poorly hidden by plain robes) emerges, eyes scanning the street with sharp interest.

FANG SHANG
I came to see the wonders I've heard of—caravan separators, strange laws, and talents that could serve the realm.

XIAO LIZI
As you wish! Onward!

FANG SHANG
(softly)
We're simple travelers, Xiao Lizi. Not an imperial procession.

XIAO LIZI
My apologies, mas— master.

The carriage inches forward through crowds.

XIAO LIZI
Master... there's talk of a woman running this county. Some say she's overturned tradition.

FANG SHANG
That remains to be seen.

FLASHBACK
continuation:
INT. PALACE - DAY (THREE YEARS AGO)

Black and white. FANG SHANG (younger, curious) stands before a glowing bronze vessel. He pins a strange badge to his robe.

The water swirls. XUE FEIFEI (20s, pink bunny pajamas, toothbrush in mouth) emerges.

Their eyes meet.

FANG SHANG
A spirit?

XUE FEIFEI
(amazed)
Time travel—

FANG SHANG
(stumbling back)
Assassin!

He looks back. She's vanished. Only the badge pulses in his hand.

FANG SHANG
(whisper)
A woman from nowhere... or from years ahead?

END FLASHBACK

EXT. PEACH BLOSSOM COUNTY STREET - DAY

FANG SHANG touches his chest where the badge hangs hidden.

FANG SHANG
Drive on.

EXT. COUNTY OFFICE ENTRANCE - DAY

XUE FEIFEI (early 20s, face half-veiled) steps out, reading a bamboo slip. The carriage clips her.

She drops the slip, catching herself mid-fall.

XUE FEIFEI
(rapid-fire)
Ow! Spine, elbow, dignity...

She tests her limbs.

XUE FEIFEI
Still functional.

FANG SHANG and XIAO LIZI approach.

FANG SHANG
You're mobile. Good. Then—

XIAO LIZI
You ran into us deliberately.

XUE FEIFEI
(brandishing the slip)
This is a marked crosswalk. Even merchants must yield.

She points to chalk lines on the ground.

LING'ER (severe bun, watchful eyes) appears at the doorway.

LING'ER
The Magistrate hears disputes at noon. Wait inside.

XUE FEIFEI
Yes.

She turns, veil slipping.

FANG SHANG
That voice—

XIAO LIZI
Master, we should depart—

FANG SHANG
(cutting him off)
This county has... unusual priorities.

LING'ER
Our priorities are fairness. Even nobles must obey the crossing law.

XIAO LIZI
You'd apply law to—the highest authority?

LING'ER
The Magistrate wrote it. All bow to precedent.

INT. COUNTY OFFICE HALL - DAY

XUE FEIFEI has shed her veil. In official robes, she strikes the gavel.

XUE FEIFEI
Court is in session!
(eyes drifting to the doorway)
Bring in the travelers from the street incident.

She fingers her sleeve's hem, where a tiny embroidered rabbit peeks out.

title: A Son's Lack of Filial Piety Is Not the Father's Fault
description: A dying father with brain cancer is abandoned by his older children, but finds hope in his youngest son who promises to care for him.
context:
Title: A Son's Lack of Filial Piety Is Not the Father's Fault
Description: A dying father with brain cancer is abandoned by his older children, but finds hope in his youngest son who promises to care for him.

INT. HOSPITAL WARD - DAY

A heart monitor beeps rhythmically.

ZHANG FUGUO lies in the hospital bed, eyes closed, receiving an IV drip.

In the ward are his eldest son ZHANG DASHAN, second daughter ZHANG YUHU, and third son ZHANG XIAOCHUAN. ZHANG DASHAN sits on another bed, scrolling through his phone with tight shoulders. ZHANG YUHU stands by the window, checking her watch. ZHANG XIAOCHUAN leans against the wall, his phone dark in his hand.

ZHANG DASHAN
Project meeting's in two hours.

ZHANG YUHU
Mom's picking up Yuanyuan at three.

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
Still no signal in here.

DOCTOR (O.S.)
Family members?

The DOCTOR appears at the ward door, holding a medical chart.

DOCTOR
Could we talk for a moment?

ZHANG DASHAN
Is it serious?

ZHANG YUHU
His blood pressure again?

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
Just tell us here, Doctor.

DOCTOR
(consulting the chart)
The MRI shows a mass. In his brain.

ZHANG YUHU
A tumor?

DOCTOR
We'll need a biopsy. But I'd like to discuss treatment options.

ZHANG DASHAN
Treatment... meaning surgery?

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
How much would that cost?

ZHANG YUHU
My husband's company just downsized.

ZHANG DASHAN
Tuition's due next month. Both kids.

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
I have a job interview tomorrow.

DOCTOR
This is a discussion for the family. I'll give you some time.

(The DOCTOR leaves. Silence.)

ZHANG YUHU
Big brother, your company—

ZHANG DASHAN
Cash flow's tight. You know expansion drained everything.

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
Yuanyuan's parents already think I'm not good enough. If they find out—

ZHANG YUHU
(checking her phone)
Dad could stay with you. Just until we figure something out.

ZHANG DASHAN
continuation:
Mei-Ling's parents live with us. You know that.

ZHANG YUHU
(softly)
Third brother, what about your place?

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
My roommate's allergic to everything. Dad would hate it.

ZHANG YUHU
Xiaohai then?

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
He hasn't answered.

ZHANG DASHAN
Call me after the biopsy. We'll... talk.

(ZHANG DASHAN exits. ZHANG YUHU looks at her phone.)

ZHANG YUHU
Daycare closes in an hour. Can you stay?

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
It's my first interview in six months.

ZHANG YUHU
Then... we'll split a nurse? Fifty-fifty?

ZHANG XIAOCHUAN
I don't have it, sister. I'm sorry.

(ZHANG XIAOCHUAN leaves. ZHANG YUHU watches him go, then looks at her father.)

ZHANG YUHU
(whispering)
Dad, I... I'm sorry.

(She hesitates, then follows her brothers out.)

(Only ZHANG FUGUO and the hospital equipment remain.)

ZHANG FUGUO slowly opens his eyes, tears welling up. He stares at the empty doorway.

ZHANG XIAOHAI (O.S.)
Excuse me.

ZHANG XIAOHAI appears at the door in a delivery uniform, breathless, holding his phone.

ZHANG XIAOHAI
Dad. I came as soon as—

(He sees his father's face.)

ZHANG XIAOHAI
Did they already leave?

ZHANG FUGUO
(whispering)
You have a wedding to save for.

ZHANG XIAOHAI
(quietly)
She'll understand. Or she won't.

(He kneels beside the bed.)

ZHANG XIAOHAI
You're my father.

ZHANG FUGUO
I didn't want to be a burden.

ZHANG XIAOHAI
You're not.

(They sit in silence as the heart monitor continues its steady rhythm.)

EXT. STREET - DAY (FLASHBACK)

Young ZHANG XIAOHAI, exhausted from work, carries a sleeping ZHANG FUGUO on his back down a quiet street. His grip tightens to keep his father from slipping. He smiles faintly, despite the weight.

title: A Son's Regret
description: A man prioritizes his father-in-law's birthday over his dying father's final wish, leading to devastating consequences.
context:
Title: A Son's Regret
Description: A man prioritizes his father-in-law's birthday over his dying father's final wish, leading to devastating consequences.

INT. STUDY - DAY

XU CHENGQI anxiously answers the phone, turning away from the celebration outside.

XU CHENGQI
Mom? I can barely hear you—what's wrong?

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER (V.O.)
(strained)
Your father... hospital... hurry...

The call drops. Xu Chengqi stares at his phone, then heads for the door.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

Balloons drift across the ceiling. The FATHER-IN-LAW, mid-70s, watches television in his birthday crown. LILIAN intercepts Xu Chengqi, her smile tightening.

LILIAN
Chengqi. Dad's cake is coming out. Where are you going?

XU CHENGQI
My father's in the hospital. That was my mother.

LILIAN
(glancing toward her father)
And we're in the middle of Dad's birthday. You promised him you'd be here.

XU CHENGQI
Lilian, this could be—he might not have long.

LILIAN
(quietly fierce)
My brother missed Dad's seventieth for a "work emergency." He cried for a week. I'm not doing that to him again. Not today.

XU CHENGQI
Please. Just let me go check—I'll be back in two hours.

LILIAN
If you walk out that door, don't bother coming back.

XU CHENGQI freezes. His hand on the doorknob. He looks back at his wife, then at his father-in-law. Slowly, he releases the knob and pulls out his phone.

XU CHENGQI
(into phone, voice hollow)
Mom. Tell Dad... I'll come tomorrow. For his birthday. First thing.

He ends the call.
continuation:
INT. BEDROOM - DAY

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER tries calling back. It goes to voicemail. She lowers the phone, defeated.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

XU CHENGQI returns to the table. The Father-in-Law studies him.

FATHER-IN-LAW
Change of plans?

XU CHENGQI
(quietly)
Family emergency. But it's... handled.

LILIAN and Xu Chengqi light candles. The Father-in-Law claps, alone.

LILIAN
(overly bright)
Make a wish, Dad!

ALL THREE
(singing, strained)
Happy birthday to you...

MONTAGE:

- In the living room, Lilian kisses her father's cheek as Xu Chengqi stares at his plate, the birthday song trailing off.
- In a crowded hospital corridor, XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER holds the phone to her husband's ear, tears streaming down her face.
- XU CHENGQI'S FATHER, oxygen mask fogging with each weak breath, hears the faint singing through the phone, his trembling hand clutching the blanket.

END MONTAGE.

INT. HOSPITAL ROOM - NIGHT

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER ends the call. The phone slips through her fingers. Her husband's eyes find hers.

XU CHENGQI'S FATHER
(whisper)
...Chengqi?

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER
(forcing a smile)
He's downstairs. Parking.

XU CHENGQI'S FATHER
The steamed buns... in the kitchen... he loved them... as a boy...

A final exhale. The heart monitor flatlines.

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER
(scream whisper)
Changgeng! You promised you'd wait—Chengqi's almost here!

FLASHBACK:

XU CHENGQI'S FATHER
Chengqi. My birthday wish... see you blow out the candles... like when you were small.

XU CHENGQI (V.O.)
I'll be there, Dad. I promise.

END FLASHBACK.

INT. OLD HOUSE MAIN HALL - DAY

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER arranges steaming buns before her husband's portrait—he's smiling in a field.

XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER
Your birthday, Changgeng. Your son... he's...

She can't finish.

EXT. OLD HOUSE ENTRANCE - DAY

An OLD NEIGHBOR opens the gate as XU CHENGQI'S MOTHER emerges with a basket of buns, still warm.

A car screeches to a halt. XU CHENGQI leaps out, tie askew.

XU CHENGQI
Mom—how is he?

He sees the buns. The basket. The black cloth on her arm.

XU CHENGQI
(softly)
...Where's Dad?

She doesn't answer. The buns steam between them in the cold morning air.

title: Internet Cafe Chaos

Title: Internet Cafe Chaos
Description: A timid technician finds himself in an awkward situation with a flirtatious customer just as an earthquake strikes the internet cafe.

INT. INTERNET CAFE - DAY

XIAO PANG sits in front of a computer, rapidly typing on the keyboard. The screen displays a BIOS interface.

XIAO PANG (V.O.)
CPU temps in the red. Classic cooling failure.

A foot wearing black stockings and platform shoes suddenly props up on XIAO PANG's desk, startling him.

FEMALE CUSTOMER sits in a gaming chair, legs on the desk, watching XIAO PANG with amusement.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
My hero. How's the rescue mission going?

XIAO PANG
(nervous)
Working on it, almost done.

FEMALE CUSTOMER pulls her legs back, sees tissues on the desk, and picks them up.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
You're drenched. Let me help.

FEMALE CUSTOMER approaches XIAO PANG with the tissue to wipe his sweat. XIAO PANG quickly dodges.

XIAO PANG
(defensive)
I've got it.

XIAO PANG takes the tissue and wipes his sweat, continuing to work on the computer.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
So... you always this dedicated? Or is this just for me?

XIAO PANG
(avoiding eye contact)
Just... doing my job.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Right. So no girlfriend waiting at home?

XIAO PANG
I... that's personal.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(teasing)
Just curious. You seem so... untouchable.

XIAO PANG immediately stands up.

XIAO PANG
Actually, this unit needs a full replacement. I'll get you another station.

XIAO PANG turns to leave. FEMALE CUSTOMER grabs his arm.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
Wait! I like this one. Just finish what you started.
continuation:
INT. INTERNET CAFE FRONT DESK - DAY

MALE CUSTOMER pounds the front desk, complaining to the FEMALE BOSS.

MALE CUSTOMER
Eight disconnections! Where's your tech support?

FEMALE BOSS
Sorry, please wait a moment, I'll get someone to fix it for you right away.

MALE CUSTOMER
Hurry up!

FEMALE BOSS watches the MALE CUSTOMER walk away, impatiently shouting into the cafe.

FEMALE BOSS
Xiao Pang! Xiao Pang! Never know what he's doing all day, can't find him when you need him.

INT. INTERNET CAFE - DAY

XIAO PANG reluctantly returns to the FEMALE CUSTOMER's computer.

XIAO PANG
Alright, let me check if the cables underneath are plugged in properly.

XIAO PANG lies on the ground, crawling under the desk to check the wiring.

FEMALE BOSS walks over, looking around for XIAO PANG, then sees him under the desk.

FEMALE BOSS bends down, looking at XIAO PANG under the desk.

FEMALE BOSS
What are you doing?

XIAO PANG
(startled)
Behind schedule, I know!

FEMALE BOSS
(suspicious)
Fixing the computer by crawling under the desk? Get up right now, there's a customer over there with a computer problem.

XIAO PANG
Okay.

XIAO PANG is about to crawl out from under the desk when FEMALE CUSTOMER suddenly looks down, pretending to be alarmed as she covers her short skirt.

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(overreacting)
Hey! What are you—

FEMALE BOSS
(severe)
Xiao Pang, get up here!

XIAO PANG
(pleading)
It's not what it looks like!

FEMALE CUSTOMER
(flustered)
I didn't— I mean, he wasn't—

The entire cafe SHAKES. Monitors topple.

MALE CUSTOMER (O.S.)
Earthquake! Under the desks!

FEMALE CUSTOMER freezes. XIAO PANG grabs her wrist.

XIAO PANG
(authoritative)
Under. Now.

He pulls her down as the lights FLICKER OUT. Darkness, dust, and the sound of structural groans.

FADE TO BLACK.

description: At a glamorous fashion show, two businessmen meet to discuss a mysterious plan involving one of the models.
context:
Title: The Fabulous Model
Description: At a glamorous fashion show, two businessmen meet to discuss a mysterious plan involving one of the models.

EXT. FASHION SHOW VENUE - NIGHT

MONTAGE - FASHION SHOW

A fast-paced montage of beautiful models walking a runway under bright, flashing lights. Upbeat, heavy rock music plays.

LAN LINGWANG, in a sparkling gown, poses confidently.

XIAO MENGYUE, in a white mini-dress, smiles sweetly.

BBB JIANG, in a strapless dress, walks with purpose.

YEZI DAREN, in a black sequined dress, dances playfully.

SHI NI YIRAN, in a gold dress, winks at the camera.

XIAO XUEHUA, in a silver dress, strikes a pose.

CAI YUE, in a red dress, blows a kiss.

GU YAN, in a golden-yellow dress, walks gracefully.

CHENG ER, in a shimmering silver dress, makes a "shush" gesture.

The montage ends. The title card appears: THE FABULOUS MODEL.

Two men, WANG ZONG and DAVID, walk towards each other in a dimly lit area outside the venue. WANG ZONG is wearing a fur-collared coat. DAVID is in a suit.

DAVID
Wang Zong.

WANG ZONG
(smiling and shaking hands)
David. You're late to your own party.
continuation:
DAVID
I was making sure the merchandise was properly displayed.

WANG ZONG
Merchandise has a way of developing opinions.

DAVID
Which is why this particular asset interests me.

DAVID takes out his phone and shows a picture to WANG ZONG. On the screen is a photo of CHENG ER—different life. Younger. Bruised.

DAVID (V.O.)
Remember this girl?

WANG ZONG stares at the photo. His smile calcifies. Recognition hits like a memory of a wound. A sharp sound effect plays.

WANG ZONG
(quietly)
I remember a debt.

DAVID
Outstanding. Now she's worth ten million dollars to the right collector.

WANG ZONG looks toward the venue. CHENG ER's silhouette moves behind glass—free, famous, unaware.

WANG ZONG
She'll recognize you.

DAVID
She won't recognize herself.

A beat. WANG ZONG's hand tightens on the phone.

WANG ZONG
Then let's make it interesting.

The sharp sound effect crescendoes with a heartbeat.

title: A Dragon's Hope: The National Scholar Returns Home
description: A brilliant scientist returns to honor his parents after receiving the nation's highest award for his groundbreaking work in controlled nuclear fusion.
context:
Title: A Dragon's Hope: The National Scholar Returns Home
Description: A brilliant scientist returns to honor his parents after receiving the nation's highest award for his groundbreaking work in controlled nuclear fusion.

INT. AWARD CEREMONY HALL - DAY

A background screen displays "National Scholar Medal Ceremony."

An elderly man with white hair (ELDER JIANG), wearing a uniform, stands at the podium delivering a speech. The audience below is packed.

ELDER JIANG
Let us give a round of applause to welcome the Father of Controlled Nuclear Fusion, Chen Ming!

Thunderous applause erupts from the audience.

The young and handsome CHEN MING, wearing a black Zhongshan suit, walks up to the stage from below. He smiles, his steps steady and confident.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
Ten years at the Advanced Research Institute. Ten years since he left the mountains.

CHEN MING walks to center stage and bows to the audience.

A CEREMONIAL HOSTESS walks onto the stage carrying a wooden box containing a golden National Scholar Medal.

ELDER JIANG takes the medal from the box.

CHEN MING (V.O.)
Dad, Mom. Ten years.

ELDER JIANG personally pins the medal on CHEN MING.

ELDER JIANG picks up a red certificate of honor and hands it to CHEN MING.

ELDER JIANG
Comrade Chen Ming, it is my honor to present you with the National Scholar Medal. For ending a century of technological containment.

CHEN MING
Elder Jiang, you are too kind.

ELDER JIANG
Not too kind. The organization instructed me: whatever you need, name it.

CHEN MING walks to the podium, holding the certificate of honor, facing the microphone.

CHEN MING
Ten years ago, my parents sold our only pig. The village pooled eggs, basket by basket. This belongs to them.

CUT TO:
continuation:
EXT. RURAL FARMHOUSE COURTYARD - DAY

ON SCREEN: Ten Years Ago

CHEN MING'S FATHER, leaning on a crutch, excitedly looks at the "Qingbei University Admission Notice" in his hand.

FATHER
We did it!

CHEN MING'S MOTHER runs out from inside the house. Seeing the notice, she cries tears of joy.

MOTHER
My son... my brilliant son...

YOUNG CHEN MING, dressed plainly, stands to the side.

YOUNG CHEN MING
Dad, I can work at the mine. I don't have to go.

Father's smile freezes. He raises his crutch, his hand trembling.

FATHER
You'd throw this back in their faces?

MOTHER
(quickly stopping him)
Old Chen! He's trying to help!

YOUNG CHEN MING
The tuition is eight hundred yuan. You haven't eaten a full meal in a week.

FATHER
My stomach troubles me. That's not your burden.

YOUNG CHEN MING
Dad...

FATHER
I limp through that mine so you wouldn't have to! You think I want to see you back here in ten years?

Father steadies himself against the doorframe.

FATHER
A man lives for his pride. Don't make me die having failed at the only thing that matters.

YOUNG CHEN MING drops to his knees with a thud, sobbing uncontrollably.

YOUNG CHEN MING
(crying out)
I'll fail. I'll waste it all!

FATHER
Then fail trying. Not here.

Father suddenly clutches his chest. His crutch slips, and he steadies himself against the wall, breathing hard.

FATHER
(quietly)
The ticket is bought, son. Don't make them take it back.

title: The Mute Woman from the Mountains
description: A mother from a mountain village loses one daughter in a tragic accident and sacrifices everything to give her surviving daughter a chance at education and a better life.
context:
Title: The Mute Woman from the Mountains
Description: A mother from a mountain village loses one daughter in a tragic accident and sacrifices everything to give her surviving daughter a chance at education and a better life.

EXT. VILLAGE ROAD - DAY

A man holds an injured little girl (JIA'ER) in his arms, surrounded by VILLAGERS. The man shouts anxiously.

MAN
Someone call for help! The ambulance!

CUIHUA and her young daughter (WAN'ER) walk down the road and see a crowd gathered ahead. CUIHUA's heart tightens. She runs over, her hands already forming desperate signs.

CUIHUA
(frantically gesturing)
[Where? My daughter? Sweet shop?]

She grabs a VILLAGER's arm, pointing toward her small roadside sweet stand, then holding her hand at Jia'er's height.

FEMALE NEIGHBOR
Cuihua... the car came too fast. Your Jia'er... she's gone. Driver fled. The Zhangs called the police.

CUIHUA collapses to her knees, her face contorted in a silent scream. She stares at the chalk outline on the pavement, touches a smudge of red clay dust - not blood, just earth. Her shoulders convulse.

WAN'ER
(crying, kneeling down)
Mama, it's my fault. I wanted the ribbon for my hair. If I hadn't kept you at the market...

CUIHUA pulls Wan'er close, pressing the girl's head to her chest. She rocks them both, her mouth open in a soundless wail.

INT. CUIHUA'S HOUSE - NIGHT

TEN YEARS LATER

CUIHUA sits on the edge of the bed, knitting by oil lamp. Her hair is steel-gray. Rain pounds the tin roof. WAN'ER bursts in, clutching a wet envelope, rainwater streaming from her braids.

WAN'ER
Mom! Mom! I got it!

She thrusts the envelope into Cuihua's hands. Cuihua's fingers tremble as she opens it. Her eyes trace the characters. A smile cracks her weathered face. She stands and touches JIA'ER's memorial photo - a faded Polaroid tucked into the mud wall.

CUIHUA
(signing gently)
[She sees you. She's proud.]

WAN'ER
Beijing Normal University. Full tuition is ten thousand yuan.

Cuihua's smile doesn't fade. She pulls a cloth bundle from under the bed - layers of fabric unfold to reveal carefully sorted bills: tens, twenties, fives. She counts. Two thousand, three hundred. Wan'er watches her mother's quick, practiced fingers.

WAN'ER
(quietly)
Mama, I could stay. Teach at the township school.

CUIHUA
(signs sharply, eyes flashing)
[No. You will go.]

She reaches under the mattress, pulls out her bankbook. Points to the balance line. Then points to Wan'er, then skyward, gesturing: "I will find more."

WAN'ER
(moved, but controlled)
Mama...

Mother and daughter embrace. Cuihua's arms are rope-muscled and strong.

MONTAGE:
- CUIHUA loads her rusted tricycle at dawn, cucumbers and bok choy arranged like jade. She pedals uphill, her calves straining.
- CUIHUA carries mortar at a construction site, her small frame bent double. A WORKER points; she nods, points to her back, loads more.
- CUIHUA works a night market stall, hands flying in sign language to customers. She clears tables, her fingers blistered.
- CUIHUA harvests rice under white sun, her sickle a silver blur. She stumbles, rights herself, keeps cutting.
- CUIHUA clutches her side at the construction site. She waves off a coworker, tries to stand, then folds slowly to the ground like a closing fan.
continuation:
INT. HOSPITAL WARD - NIGHT

CUIHUA lies in bed, an oxygen mask covering her face. WAN'ER sits beside her, now a young woman in a university sweater. A DOCTOR enters with a clipboard.

WAN'ER
She opened her eyes once. Didn't sign.

DOCTOR
Your mother's coworker brought her medical card. She's been buying painkillers for months. The scans show advanced renal failure. She needs surgery within weeks.

Cuihua's eyes flutter open. She sees the doctor, sees the clipboard with cost estimates. She tears the mask off.

CUIHUA
(gasping, signing weakly)
[No. Wan'er's last year.]

WAN'ER
(firmly, tears streaming)
Mama, if you die, I leave school. I come back here. I plant rice. That's the end.

CUIHUA
(trying to rise, face pale)
[My life is mine to spend!]

WAN'ER
(holding her down)
And my life is mine to lose if you go!

The two women lock eyes. Cuihua's hands fall still. Wan'er turns to the doctor.

WAN'ER
She'll have the surgery. I'll get the money.

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

TEN YEARS LATER

CUIHUA sits at her doorstep, hair pure white. She shells peanuts with quick fingers, dropping them in a bowl. A few NEIGHBORS chat not far away.

NEIGHBOR
Her daughter's doing well in Jinghai. Two children now. Sends money every month.

CUIHUA hears this, slowly lifts her head, her eyes filled with complex emotions. She looks at the paved road leading out of the village, runs a finger along the rim of a porcelain bowl Wan'er sent last Spring Festival. Her hands remember the weight of mortar, the burn of hot oil. The bowl is empty. She fills it with shelled nuts anyway, arranges them in a neat circle, a silent offering.

A car horn sounds. She doesn't look up. The neighbors scatter. She keeps shelling, her fingers steady, her face giving nothing away.

title: Motherless Love
description: A mother sacrifices everything, including her own kidney and dignity, to save her son's life and send him to university.
context:
Title: Motherless Love
Description: A mother sacrifices everything, including her own kidney and dignity, to save her son's life and send him to university.

INT. HOSPITAL CORRIDOR - DAY

Tense music.

A DOCTOR and NURSES push a hospital bed carrying WANG BIN rapidly forward. WANG CUIFEN follows anxiously beside them.

DOCTOR
Acute renal failure. We need to get him to surgery now.

WANG CUIFEN tries to follow into the operating room but is stopped by the DOCTOR.

DOCTOR
You can't go in. Wait here.

WANG CUIFEN grips the DOCTOR's arm, her voice trembling.

WANG CUIFEN
Doctor, please. Wang Bin just got into university. He's... he's everything.

DOCTOR
(gently removing her hand)
His kidney function is critically compromised. He'll likely need a transplant. But we don't have a donor match available.

WANG CUIFEN
I've already been tested. My kidney is compatible. Please.

DOCTOR
You're not an ideal candidate. The surgery carries significant risk for someone your age.

WANG CUIFEN
(quietly intense)
He's my son. I'll sign whatever you need.

The DOCTOR studies her face, sees her resolve, then nods once.

DOCTOR
Wait here. We'll do everything we can.

WANG CUIFEN watches them disappear through the doors, pressing a trembling hand to her mouth.

TRANSITION: Two months later, Xiushui Village
continuation:
EXT. XIUSHUI VILLAGE - DAY

WANG CUIFEN carries a cloth bundle, moving with determination despite her slower gait.

WANG CUIFEN (V.O.)
Two eggs a day. That's what the doctor said I could spare. Fifty eggs should be worth something.

WANG CUIFEN stops at a modest house and knocks.

WANG CUIFEN
Uncle Wang? It's Cuifen.

WANG CHENG opens the door, sees her, and his expression softens with pity.

WANG CHENG
Cuifen. I heard about the surgery. How's the boy?

WANG CUIFEN
Recovering well. But... the medical bills took everything. And now there's tuition.

She unwraps the bundle to reveal carefully packed eggs.

WANG CUIFEN
(quietly)
I know these won't cover it. But if you could lend me the rest, I'll work it off. I can clean, cook, work the fields...

WANG CHENG
(sighs heavily)
I just had to pay for my wife's treatment. We're stretched thin.

He disappears inside. WANG CUIFEN stands frozen, not breathing. He returns with an envelope.

WANG CHENG
It's not much. Three thousand. But it's yours.

WANG CUIFEN tries to refuse, but he presses it into her hand.

WANG CUIFEN
I'll repay every cent. I swear it.

WANG CHENG
Just get that boy educated. That's repayment enough.

He closes the door gently. WANG CUIFEN stands there, clutching the envelope and eggs, tears streaming down her face.

TRANSITION: A few days later

EXT. VILLAGE ENTRANCE - DAY

WANG BIN, now healthier, adjusts his backpack. WANG CUIFEN touches his sleeve nervously. VILLAGERS watch from a distance.

WANG CUIFEN
Call me when you arrive. And don't skip meals. I sent some dried mushrooms with your things.

WANG BIN
Mom, you need to rest more. The doctor said—

WANG CUIFEN
(interrupting)
—I'm fine. You just focus on your studies.

The VILLAGE CHIEF approaches, holding a small red envelope.

VILLAGE CHIEF
Wang Bin. The village collected this. For your books.

WANG BIN
Chief, I can't—

VILLAGE CHIEF
You can. Your mother carried water for eight families last week while her incision was still healing. We know what this cost.

WANG BIN stares at his mother, understanding finally hitting him fully. He takes the envelope with trembling hands.

WANG BIN
(whispering)
Mom... your kidney. The doctor told me you insisted. You didn't tell me about the pain, the work...

WANG CUIFEN
You needed to focus on getting well.

WANG BIN drops to his knees, not in performance, but as if his legs can no longer hold him.

WANG BIN
I thought I understood. I didn't.

WANG CUIFEN pulls him up, fierce and tender.

WANG CUIFEN
You understand now. That's enough.

The BUS DRIVER leans out.

DRIVER
Last call!

WANG BIN boards, looking back. WANG CUIFEN waves once, strong and steady. As the bus pulls away, she finally lets her hand drop, her shoulders sagging with exhaustion and relief.

title: Giving Up Hope
description: A woman endures emotional neglect and abuse from her fiancé who cannot let go of his ex-girlfriend, until a broken cup becomes the final straw.
context:
Title: Giving Up Hope
Description: A woman endures emotional neglect and abuse from her fiancé who cannot let go of his ex-girlfriend, until a broken cup becomes the final straw.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

WEN ZHIXIAN, wearing a white shirt, curls up in the corner of the bathroom, letting cold water from the shower pour over her entire body. She covers her face with both hands, crying silently.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
Hope doesn't fracture. It erodes.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

WEN ZHIXIAN carries a cup of coffee, smiling as she walks toward GU YUCHEN, who sits on the sofa reviewing contracts.

WEN ZHIXIAN
Yuchen, I made that Ethiopian blend you like—

GU YUCHEN doesn't look up, his hand swats impatiently.

GU YUCHEN
I said no distractions.

GU YUCHEN stands up abruptly, knocking into WEN ZHIXIAN. Coffee spills across his sleeve. He curses under his breath, walking away without a glance back. WEN ZHIXIAN watches his back, the smile fading.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
His words were sharpening.

INT. LIVING ROOM - DAY

WEN ZHIXIAN sits on the sofa, phone pressed to her ear, her posture eager.

WEN ZHIXIAN
(into the phone)
Yuchen, you won't believe what happened at the gallery today—

The line disconnects. She stares at the screen, the moment stretching.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
Every silence grew heavier.
continuation:
EXT. STREET SIDE - NIGHT

GU YUCHEN is drunk, leaning against a utility pole. WEN ZHIXIAN supports him, struggling with his weight.

GU YUCHEN suddenly grips her chin, his eyes focusing with drunken clarity.

GU YUCHEN
(murmuring)
Your jaw... it's all wrong. Not like hers.

He shoves her away. WEN ZHIXIAN stumbles, catching herself against a wall. She watches him sink to the ground, the truth pooling like blood.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
Truths spoken like accidents.

INT. BATHROOM - NIGHT

Flashback. WEN ZHIXIAN breaks down crying under the shower.

INT. LIVING ROOM - NIGHT

WEN ZHIXIAN kneels on the floor, cleaning up broken coffee cup pieces. Her injured hand trembles. Her gaze falls on a mug with a cartoon pattern, tucked in the back of the cabinet—different from their usual set.

WEN ZHIXIAN (V.O.)
But I never imagined the last straw would be something so small.

She reaches for it. Her fingers slip. The mug falls, shattering on the tile—not with a crash, but a soft, final sound.

GU YUCHEN hears the sound and rushes over.

GU YUCHEN
(roaring)
Wen Zhixian!

He glares at WEN ZHIXIAN furiously.

GU YUCHEN
Didn't I tell you not to touch this cup? Do you know it's...

WEN ZHIXIAN
(interrupting, voice breaking)
I know. I know it's from her. But I didn't—

GU YUCHEN
Don't touch me! You think I'll believe you? You're just narrow-minded, you can't tolerate anything related to Zhaomu!

WEN ZHIXIAN
(her own fury rising)
Then why is it here? In our home? With our wedding invitations on the table!

She points to the mantle where a photo of GU YUCHEN and another woman sits half-hidden behind a plant.

GU YUCHEN
(quietly venomous)
Don't you dare speak her name.

He raises his hand. The slap cracks across her face. WEN ZHIXIAN's head snaps. She touches her cheek, disbelief giving way to something harder.

Flashback. GU YUCHEN fastens a pearl bracelet on WEN ZHIXIAN's wrist, his voice earnest.

GU YUCHEN (V.O.)
This can be our beginning.

Back to reality. WEN ZHIXIAN looks at the bracelet. She twists it until the string snaps. Pearls scatter, bouncing across the hardwood.

WEN ZHIXIAN
(not a question)
You asked me to build a life on ground you never left.

She places the broken string in GU YUCHEN's hand and turns to leave.

GU YUCHEN stands frozen, the string coiled in his palm like a dead thing.

WEN ZHIXIAN pauses at the threshold. She looks back. Then, methodically, she walks back and slaps him—not in fury, but with the weight of finality. The sound echoes.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED...

title: Dark Forest Encounter
description: A young woman saves a poisoned heir in a dark forest, leading to a fateful meeting that intertwines their destinies as she becomes entangled in a murder conspiracy.
context:
Title: Dark Forest Encounter
Description: A young woman saves a poisoned heir in a dark forest, leading to a fateful meeting that intertwines their destinies as she becomes entangled in a murder conspiracy.

INT. DARK FOREST - NIGHT

A rainy night, lightning and thunder flash through the trees. Rain pours through the canopy in sheets.

LING YING, wearing simple clothes and a bamboo hat, runs frantically through the muddy path, constantly looking back at pursuing flashlights.

She slips and falls toward a ravine—

A hand shoots out. QIN YANSHI, white shirt and black leather jacket soaked through, face pale and weak, catches her wrist and pulls her to safety.

In the distance, flashlight beams and pursuing voices can be heard.

PURSUER (V.O.)
There's movement over there, spread out! Catch him!

LING YING
(urgent whisper)
Follow me.

LING YING pulls QIN YANSHI to hide behind a rocky overhang. The pursuers pass by with flashlights and clubs.

QIN YANSHI trembles, poison making his muscles spasm. He notices the purple veins visible on his hands.

PURSUER LEADER (V.O.)
Remember: Qin Yanshi's been injected. He can't have gone far. Check every crevice.

The pursuers move past. QIN YANSHI releases his grip on the rock, his body swaying. He focuses on LING YING's silver ring with a distinctive lotus design.

QIN YANSHI
(strained)
That ring... proof you helped me...

He twists it—the ring separates into two halves. He pockets one half.

LING YING
What are you—

QIN YANSHI
Promise I'll find you...

QIN YANSHI collapses against the rock, unconscious. LING YING looks at him, then at the half-ring, conflicted.

FADE TO:

EXT. HILLSIDE - DAY

Golden sunrise. QIN YANSHI has changed into a clean white shirt. A DOCTOR is taking a blood sample. SECRETARY XU stands nearby.

SECRETARY XU
Young Master, we've searched the entire mountain. No trace of the woman. Do you recall any identifying features?

QIN YANSHI
(recalling)
Only that ring. Silver. Splits in two. Find it, and you find her.

He holds up the half-ring, letting light catch the lotus etching.

QIN YANSHI
She saved my life. Use every resource.
continuation:
INT. JIANG FAMILY LIVING ROOM - DAY

JIANG MOTHER and JIANG FATHER sit on the sofa. Their daughter LING YAN anxiously paces.

JIANG MOTHER
The Qin matriarch is dead. They found the car—a rental under our family name. If they trace it—

LING YAN
(voice breaking)
I didn't mean to—to hit her that hard. She recognized me, she was going to expose the deal—

JIANG FATHER
(interrupting)
Enough. The rental agreement uses Ling Ying's identity. It's clean.

At the doorway, LING YING, now wearing a white dress, walks in and overhears. Shock and betrayal cross her face.

LING YING
You sent me away because you couldn't afford three children. I worked three jobs to get into Beijing University, thinking we could finally—

JIANG MOTHER
(desperate)
Ying'er, there's been a terrible accident. Your sister—she was driving. A woman was hit. But the car... it was rented using your ID months ago.

LING YING
My ID? You took my documents when I left—

LING YAN
(approaching)
It was an accident. Please. I'll spend my life making it up to you.

LING YAN notices the silver lotus ring on LING YING's hand.

LING YAN
That ring...

She grabs Ling Ying's hand, examining it.

LING YAN
Let me hold onto it for now. For safekeeping.

LING YING
No! It's from Grandma—

LING YAN
The grandmother who gave you away? I'll keep it safe.

Ling Yan pulls the ring off, trying it on. It fits. Ling Ying lunges, but JIANG FATHER restrains her.

EXT. JIANG FAMILY ENTRANCE - DAY

LING YING is escorted out, hands bound with zip ties. A black sedan pulls up.

SECRETARY XU and QIN YANSHI exit the car. JIANG MOTHER approaches.

JIANG MOTHER
May I help you?

SECRETARY XU
I represent Qin Corporation security. We're investigating the matriarch's death.

LING YAN
(internal monologue)
Qin Corporation? They found the car already?

LING YAN immediately points at the restrained LING YING.

LING YAN
She's the one you want! She confessed to everything!

LING YING sees QIN YANSHI. Recognition and hope flare in her eyes.

LING YING
(internal monologue)
It's him. If he remembers the forest, he knows I wasn't driving. I was saving him.

QIN YANSHI's gaze falls on LING YING, then on the ring gleaming on LING YAN's finger.

QIN YANSHI
(internal monologue)
The ring... but the woman in the forest was different. I felt her urgency, her kindness.

He pulls out his half. The lotus patterns match.

QIN YANSHI
(to Ling Yan)
Miss, where did you acquire that ring?

LING YAN
(nervously)
Family heirloom. Passed down.

QIN YANSHI
(to Secretary Xu)
Run facial analysis on last night's thermal footage. Cross-reference with these women.

He looks between the sisters, suspicion growing.

QIN YANSHI
One of you was in that forest last night. The truth will show which.

ON SCREEN: TO BE CONTINUED

title: Sin and Sugar
description: A desperate young woman encounters a mysterious injured man while trying to save her sick mother, leading to a fateful night that changes everything.
context:
Title: Sin and Sugar
Description: A desperate young woman encounters a mysterious injured man while trying to save her sick mother, leading to a fateful night that changes everything.

INT. CAMPING CANOPY - NIGHT

GU NIAN, LIU RUQING, and two other classmates (one male, one female) sit around a table.

GU NIAN
Excuse me, I need to take a call.

GU NIAN gets up and leaves.

FEMALE CLASSMATE
Isn't she the eldest daughter of the Gu family? Why is she borrowing money from us at a camping party?

LIU RUQING
(pouring tea)
Her mother is dying. Some debts you can't outrun.

EXT. WISHING TREE - NIGHT

GU NIAN stands under a tree covered with red ribbons, anxiously making a phone call.

GU NIAN
(into phone, voice choking)
Dad, I'm only short a hundred thousand yuan. Mom's illness can't be delayed any longer.

FATHER (V.O.)
Then stop prolonging it. Your sister got into a car accident and hit someone.

GU NIAN
(agitated)
She's not my sister, she's your illegitimate daughter!

The call is disconnected. Busy tone. GU NIAN stares at her phone in despair, tears streaming down her face.

GU NIAN
(looking up, praying)
God, why don't you punish the bad people instead of tormenting my mother? Who can help me?

A man (LU CHENZHOU) suddenly runs past her from behind, knocking GU NIAN down. They both fall on the grass.

GU NIAN
Ah!

GU NIAN helps LU CHENZHOU sit up.

GU NIAN
Sir, are you alright?

LU CHENZHOU
(weakly)
Help me. No hospitals.

In the distance, two PURSUERS in suits are searching.

PURSUER A
Split up. You go that way.

LU CHENZHOU
(grabbing GU NIAN's arm)
Help me, help me.

GU NIAN
Come!

GU NIAN helps LU CHENZHOU up, and they stumble into a nearby tent.
continuation:
EXT. TENT - NIGHT

The two PURSUERS approach the tent. A silhouette is projected on the tent showing GU NIAN kneeling over LU CHENZHOU, performing CPR motions—rhythmic, medical, urgent.

PURSUER A
(contemptuously)
Hmph, a camper practicing first aid. Let's go.

The PURSUERS turn and leave.

INT. TENT - NIGHT

GU NIAN
(relieved)
They're gone. It's okay now.

GU NIAN notices LU CHENZHOU's black turtleneck is torn, with blood on his collarbone.

GU NIAN
(panicked)
Sir, you're hurt!

LU CHENZHOU's eyes are unfocused. He suddenly pulls GU NIAN down as his knees buckle, collapsing behind crates.

LU CHENZHOU
(breathing heavily)
I'm sorry. I was drugged. Can't stay awake.

GU NIAN
(struggling to support him)
Then let me help.

The light in the tent flickers, implying they remain through the night—her monitoring his breathing, not relations.

EXT. TENT - NIGHT

GU NIAN runs out of the tent disheveled and falls to the ground. LIU RUQING walks over from a distance and sees this.

LIU RUQING
(puzzled, to herself)
Why is she in such a panic?

EXT. WISHING TREE - NIGHT

The PURSUERS return to the tree.

LU CHENZHOU (V.O.)
(voice weaker)
Find that woman for me. She has what I need.

EXT. ROADSIDE - NIGHT

GU NIAN sits alone by the roadside, hugging herself and shivering, wearing glasses, crying helplessly. Her phone vibrates.

She picks up the phone and sees a photo: a woman in a hospital coat standing by her mother's bedside, holding a document: "TREATMENT AUTHORIZATION: PENDING PAYMENT."

GU NIAN
(terrified)
Mom...

GU NIAN immediately makes a call.

GU NIAN
(crying into phone)
What do you want?

THREATENER (V.O.)
Come to the hospital immediately. Otherwise, your mother's treatment authorization will be revoked.

GU NIAN's face is filled with fear and despair.

context:
Title: Revenge of a Grieving Mother
Description: A woman plots to destroy her husband and his family after they caused the death of her newborn son through their negligence and cruelty.

INT. DIMLY LIT ROOM - NIGHT

QINQIN, a woman in a black business suit, walks determinedly into a dimly lit room. BOSS XU sits behind a desk.

QINQIN (V.O.)
The loan defaults in seven days. By then, every asset we own will be worthless to him.

QINQIN sits down across from BOSS XU.

BOSS XU examines the marriage certificate and property deed, then studies QINQIN.

BOSS XU
You're destroying your own credit to ruin him.

QINQIN
(coldly precise)
He deserves to lose everything.

BOSS XU
What justifies this?

QINQIN
(quiet rage)
His family killed my son. He chose to let it happen.

EXT. PARK - DAY (FLASHBACK)

FIVE MONTHS AGO

QINQIN, eight months pregnant in a blue maternity dress, sits on a park bench speaking softly on her phone.

QINQIN
(on the phone)
Checkup went perfectly. Four weeks to go.

Nearby, SISTER-IN-LAW guides her son JIAHUI on a bicycle.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Jiahui, ease up on the pedals. Gentle turn—yes, like that!

She releases the bike. JIAHUI wobbles, loses control. The bicycle veers toward QINQIN.

JIAHUI
(panicked)
Can't stop!

QINQIN turns. The front wheel strikes her side. QINQIN falls from the bench. JIAHUI topples over.

SISTER-IN-LAW rushes forward, her face flickering between alarm and calculation.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Jiahui!

QINQIN lies curled on the ground, breathing sharply, hands cradling her belly.

QINQIN
The baby...

JIAHUI cries, a shallow scrape on his elbow. SISTER-IN-LAW kneels by him first.

SISTER-IN-LAW
Let me see—just a scratch. You'll be fine.

QINQIN's husband AYUE runs over, his phone still in hand.

AYUE
What happened—Jesus, Qinqin!

He crouches beside QINQIN.
continuation:
QINQIN
(clenched teeth)
Contractions. Something's wrong.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(over her shoulder)
Ayue, Jiahui's arm needs cleaning. The handlebar caught him.

JIAHUI
(whimpering)
Mom, it stings...

QINQIN
We need the hospital. Now.

AYUE
Right—I'll get the car, we can—

SISTER-IN-LAW
(interrupting)
Qinqin's not due for weeks. It's probably false labor from the shock.

QINQIN
(gasping)
This isn't false. I'm bleeding.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(pleading)
Ayue, your brother died when Jiahui was a baby. He's all I have left. Please—just get him checked first. Ten minutes.

AYUE looks between them.

QINQIN
Ayue. Don't leave me here.

SISTER-IN-LAW
(to QINQIN)
You're an adult. You can wait. He's a child.

(to AYUE)
She's fine. Women carry babies through worse. But Jiahui—what if it's worse than it looks?

JIAHUI
(pale)
Mom, I feel dizzy...

SISTER-IN-LAW
See? Ayue, I'm begging you.

She grips AYUE's arm, tears forming.

AYUE
(agonized)
Qinqin... it's just ten minutes. I'll be right back.

QINQIN
(pleading)
Please. I can't stand up.

AYUE
Wait here. I'll send an ambulance from the car.

SISTER-IN-LAW
She doesn't need an ambulance, she needs to breathe. Come on.

SISTER-IN-LAW pulls AYUE up. He looks back once, then guides JIAHUI away, moving faster with each step.

QINQIN watches them leave, clutching her stomach. A dark stain spreads on her dress. Her breathing shallows.

QINQIN
(voice breaking)
It hurts...

She's alone. The phone lies broken beside her.

title: The Bitter Stepmother Awakens and Goes Wild
description: A renowned actress known for tragic roles collapses at an awards ceremony and awakens in an ancient world, inhabiting the body of a mistreated daughter who was just murdered.
context:
Title: The Bitter Stepmother Awakens and Goes Wild
Description: A renowned actress known for tragic roles collapses at an awards ceremony and awakens in an ancient world, inhabiting the body of a mistreated daughter who was just murdered.

INT. AWARDS CEREMONY RED CARPET - NIGHT

The SOUND of camera shutters click like machine gun fire. Fans SCREAM from behind velvet ropes.

RUAN QINGXUAN, mid-30s, glides down the red carpet in a sapphire gown that catches every flash. She clutches two golden trophies, her face a mask of practiced serenity. BODYGUARDS flank her, creating a bubble of space.

HOST (V.O.)
This just in—Ruan Qingxuan sweeps Best Actress and the prestigious Tearjerker Award for her devastating performance in "The Abandoned Wife."

Reporters surge forward, microphones stabbing the air like spears.

YOUNG REPORTER
Miss Ruan! Your thoughts on the double win?

Ruan stops. Turns. The cameras love her, but her eyes hold something else—exhaustion flickering beneath the perfection.

RUAN QINGXUAN
I'm grateful. Truly. But after twelve years of playing victims, I have to ask—why does everyone see tragedy when they look at me? I can be more. I want to be more.

She holds up the trophies.

RUAN QINGXUAN (CONT'D)
So this is my last time holding these. No more tears. No more suffering. I'm done.

The reporters explode with questions. Ruan takes one step, then—

Her face drains of color. She grips her head, a look of pure terror crossing her features.

RUAN QINGXUAN
No—not again—

She collapses. The trophies CLATTER on marble. Her head smacks the red carpet.

CHAOS erupts. Bodyguards rush in. Reporters press closer.

YOUNG REPORTER
Someone call a doctor! Miss Ruan! Miss Ruan!
continuation:
INT. MOURNING HALL - DAY

Silence. Thick incense chokes the air.

Ruan Qingxuan lies on a wooden funeral bed, drapin white burial silks. Her eyes snap open.

MEMORIES slam into her—fragmented, violent, not her own:
- A newborn's cry, a father's disappointed scowl
- Small hands scrubbing clothes in freezing water
- A shove from behind, the shock of icy water filling lungs
- A scroll being read: "By imperial decree..."
- Ruan Yuyao's sneering face: "You'll never be more than a concubine's daughter..."

Ruan's chest heaves. She focuses on a figure across the room.

NINGSHUANG, a teenage maid, kneels before RUAN YUYAO, early 20s, who wears silk robes that scream privilege.

RUAN YUYAO
You dare accuse me? Your precious Second Miss slipped and fell. Her own clumsiness killed her.

NINGSHUANG
I saw you push her! For that marriage decree—you wanted—

Ruan Yuyao's fan snaps shut.

RUAN YUYAO
Guards.

Two burly MAIDS seize Ningshuang, forcing her to her knees.

NINGSHUANG
(struggling)
What are you—

RUAN YUYAO
Since you're so devoted, go serve her in hell.

Ningshuang's eyes lock onto Ruan's body, tears streaming.

NINGSHUANG
Second Miss! I'll find you in the next life!

Ruan Yuyao raises a heavy wooden club, her face a mask of genteel cruelty.

RUAN YUYAO
Such touching loyalty. Let's make it quick.

Ruan Yuyao swings—

Ruan Qingxuan sits bolt upright, the silk shroud sliding off.

RUAN QINGXUAN
Seriously? Can't a corpse get some fucking sleep around here?

The club freezes mid-air. Ningshuang's mouth falls open. A tiny vase drops from someone's hand, SHATTERING.

RUAN YUYAO
(whispered horror)
A... a jiangshi...

RUAN QINGXUAN
Jiang—what?

Ruan's head whips around. Her gaze lands on the memorial tablet: "Spirit Tablet of Deceased Daughter—RUAN QINGXUAN."

The name hits her like a second blow. The memories crystallize.

RUAN QINGXUAN
(softly, to herself)
Oh no. I've become... her.

Ningshuang scrambles free, crawling to clutch Ruan's hand.

NINGSHUANG
Second Miss! Your heart still beats! Thank the heavens—

Ruan stares at their joined hands. The girl's joy is so raw, so real. A stranger's devotion, now hers to bear.

RUAN QINGXUAN
(quiet, modern steel in her voice)
Alright then. Let's see what kind of tragedy this script really is.

Title: Bound Betrayal
Description: A woman in white awakens to find herself captive in a twisted plot orchestrated by her husband's obsessed admirer.

INT. BEDROOM - DAY

A woman in white lies on the floor beside the bed, her hands bound behind her back. She awakens gradually, confusion hardening into guarded awareness.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(hushed)
Is anyone there?

The bedroom door opens. SHANG XUE enters in a black dress.

SHANG XUE
You're awake sooner than expected.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(measured)
Shang Xue. I hoped I was wrong.

SHANG XUE
(smiling without warmth)
Don't worry. As long as you obey, I won't take your life.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(quietly fierce)
What does obedience look like today?

SHANG XUE produces a small vial, rolling it between her fingers.

SHANG XUE
Something to blur the lines between loyalty and instinct. When Yuchen sees the footage, he'll question everything he thought he knew about his perfect wife.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(struggling)
Don't come near me.

SHANG XUE steps forward and grips the Woman's jaw, vial ready.

SHANG XUE
I was his family. Before you made him choose propriety over blood. Swallow it. After he sees what you become, he won't want the reminder.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(steady)
The staff know I'm here. Any minute—
continuation:
SHANG XUE
(mocking)
The staff are enjoying their unexpected holiday. Your husband's orders.

A suited man (SUITED MAN) appears in the doorway.

SHANG XUE
(to SUITED MAN)
Mark the time. Authentic timestamps.

SUITED MAN
(nodding)
Camera's rolling.

SHANG XUE
Make it convincing. Nothing that leaves evidence.

The Suited Man approaches, removing his cufflinks with methodical precision. A phone on the dresser captures the scene.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(coldly)
He's paying you for performance, not improvisation. What's your actual price?

SUITED MAN
(pausing)
Some performances are their own reward.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(lower, urgent)
Triple. Before she pays you at all. Account numbers in my purse—check the lining.

The Suited Man hesitates, his eyes flickering toward the door.

SHANG XUE
(from across the room)
Don't entertain her games.

WOMAN IN WHITE
(to Suited Man)
She's already shown you you're disposable. Are you?

The Suited Man's hand stops mid-reach.
